sa: जाग्रत्स्वपुंश्च कौन्तेय कर्णमेव सदा ह्यहम्। पश्यामि तत्र तत्रैव कर्णभूतमिदं जगत्॥
en: Even while awake, O Arjuna, I see his illusion (of Karna) and it seems as if the whole universe is filled with Karna.

sa: अनुसृत्य तु ये धर्मं कथयेयुरुपस्थिताः। समासाविस्तरविदां न तेषां वेत्सि निश्चयम्॥
en: You know not the words of wisdom the learned men preach, after the rules of morality, to the pupils waiting up on them.

sa: स त्वं धर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठं राजानं धर्मसंहितम्। प्रसादय कुरुश्रेष्ठमेतदत्र मतं मम॥
en: I adjure you, therefore, to assuage the sorrows of the pious king, the adored of the devout and the head of the Kurus.

sa: येत त्वं पीडितो बाणैदृढमायम्य कार्मुकम्। तस्याद्य कर्मणः कर्णः फलमाप्स्यति दारुणम्॥
en: Karna, who had afflicted you with his arrows shot from a full-drawn bow, would reap the dire effects of his act, this day.

sa: ऐश्वर्यमदसम्मूढो नैष दुःखमुपेयिवान्। न च ते संयुगे वीर्ये जानाति पुरुषर्षभ॥
en: Elated with the pride engendered by his prosperity, he has never experienced pain. O foremost of men, he knows your prowess in battle.

sa: सेयं पार्थ चमूर्घोरा धार्तराष्ट्रस्य संयुगे॥ हतसर्वस्ववीरा हि भीष्मद्रोणौ यदा हतौ।
en: O Partha, now that Bhishma and Drona are slain, the fierce Dhritarashtra force may well be regarded to have lost all their heroes.

sa: गाण्डीव प्रहितान् घोरानद्य गात्रैः स्पृशञ्छरान्॥ कर्णः स्मरतु दुष्टात्मा वचनं द्रोणभीष्मयोः।
en: Let the wicked Karna feel the pangs of those deadly shafts sped from the Gandiva and remember the words of Bhishma and Drona.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच एष केतू रणे सूतपुत्रस्य दृश्यते। भीमसेनादयश्चैते योधयन्ति महारथम्॥
en: Arjuna said "O Krishna, I see the banner of Suta our troops, with Bhimasena at their head are fighting with that mighty car-warrior.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु पार्थेन केशवः प्रत्युवाच तम्। म्माप्येतन्मतं पार्थ यदिदं ते प्रभाषितम्॥
en: Thus spoken to by Pritha's son, Keshava replied to him saying-"O Partha, I am also of the same opinion that you have expressed."

sa: विगाह्य च गजानीकं प्रगृह्य महतीं गदाम्। क्षणेन भीमः संक्रुद्धस्तन्निन्ये यमसादनम्॥
en: Thus entering the army Bhima by the help of his mighty mace sent them all to the region of Pluto in no time.

sa: ततः प्रवृते युद्धं त्वरतां सर्वधन्विनाम्। कुरूणां पाण्डवानां च संक्रुद्धानां परस्परम्॥
en: Then raged the encounter between all the enraged bowmen of the Kurus and the Pandavas, all eater for encountering each other in fight.

sa: ततस्तौ समरे शूरौ योधयन्तौ परस्परम्। ददृशुः सर्वसैन्यानि शक्रजम्भौ यथा पुरा॥
en: Then all the troops beheld these heroes each fighting with the other, appear like Shakra and Jambha fighting in the days of yore.

sa: यमुपाश्रित्य संग्रामे कृतः शस्त्रमुद्यमः। स को निर्जितः संख्ये हतश्चैव जयद्रथः॥
en: Even Karna, depending upon whom, I had engaged in this passage at arms in battle, has been defeated in encounter and Jayadratha slain.

sa: बलं संकर्षणे नित्यं सौकुमार्य पुनर्गदे। रूपेण मत्तः प्रद्युम्नः सोऽसहायोऽस्मि नारद॥
en: Power lives in Sankarshana; mildness in Gada; and as regards Pradyumna, he excels even myself in beauty. Still I am helpless, O Narada!

sa: यस्त्वं प्राणविरोधेन कीर्तिमिच्छसि शाश्वतीम्। सा ते प्राणान् गमिष्यति न संशयः॥
en: There is no doubt that the everlasting renown which you long for at the cost of your life, will deprive you of it.

sa: कथं ह्यस्मद्विधो ब्रह्मन् वर्तमानो गृहाश्रमे। भरणं पालनं चापि न कुर्यादनुयायिनाम्॥
en: O Brahmana, for what purpose would one like to lead a domestic life, if he cannot cherish and support those that follow him?

sa: तदुभावेव भवन्तावुदारौ य इदानीं भवद्भ्यामन्यतमः सोऽपसर्पतु एतद् वै निदर्शनमित्युक्त्वा तूष्णीं नारदो बभूव। एतच्छ्रुत्वा तु कौरव्यः शिबिं प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा दत्त्वा पन्थानं बहुकर्मभिः प्रशस्य प्रययौ॥
en: Both of you are generous-minded. Let one of you stand aside (giving the way to the other) according to the above words Having said this, Narada became silent. Having heard this, the descendant of Kuru, (king Suhotra), walking round Shivi and praising his many good deeds, gave him the way and went away.

sa: संजय उवाच ततो युधिष्ठिरश्चैव भीमसेनश्च पाण्डवः। द्रोणपुत्रं महाराज समन्तात् पर्यवारयन्॥
en: Sanjaya said Then, O great monarch, king Yudhishthira and Bhimasena the son of Pandu hemmed in the son of Drona on all sides.

sa: आपो वायुश्च तेजश्च त्रयमेतदकल्पयत्। स सृष्ट्वा पृथिवीं देवीं सर्वलोकेश्वरः प्रभुः॥
en: He created these three things viz., Water, Air, and Fire. Having created this Earth, that Divine Master, the Lord of all the worlds.

sa: अन्वगच्छन् महाराज मत्स्यैश्च सह सोमकैः। तथैव तव पुत्रस्य रथोदाराः प्रहारिणः॥
en: And the Matsyas together with the Somakas followed. In like manner, (many) car-warriors, who wore (efficient) smiters on the side of your son.

sa: दमयन्ती तु यं हंसं समुपाधावदन्तिके। स मानुषी गिरं कृत्वा दमयन्तीमथाब्रवीत्॥
en: The swan which Damayanti pursued, led her into a solitary corner of the gardens and addressed her a human speech the following words,

sa: निग्रहं धर्मराजस्य प्रकरिष्यति संयुगे। ततो निक्षिप्य राजानं धृष्टद्युम्ने च पाण्डवम्॥
en: Will never succeed in humiliating king Yudhishthira the virtuous," Thereafter making the charge of protecting the royal son of Pandu over to Dhrishtadyumna.

sa: निर्मुच्यमानः पापेभ्यो घनेभ्य इव चन्द्रमाः। विरजाः कालमाकाङ्क्षन् धीरो धैर्येण सिद्ध्यति॥
en: Freed from sin like the Moon from misty clouds, the wise man, shining in resplendence, acquires success by patiently waiting for his time.

sa: नास्तिकान् भिन्नमर्यादान् क्रूरान् पापमतौ स्थितान्। त्यज तान् ज्ञानमाश्रित्य धार्मिकानुपसेव्य च॥
en: Forsake the atheists, who are notorious, wicked and always entertain cruel ideas. Take shelter under knowledge and always worship those, that are virtuous.

sa: तदद्भुतं सर्वमनुष्ययोधाः संदृष्टवन्तो निहते स्म कर्णे। दृष्ट्वा कर्णं पातितं फाल्गुनन॥
en: This wonderful spectacle was wiinessed by all the on-lookers after Karna's fall. Then seeing Karna slain by Phalguna the Pandavas blew their conchs.

sa: एवं स वसते तत्र क्षिप्तः संसारसागरे। न चैव जीविताशायां निर्वेदमुपगच्छति॥
en: He lived in that condition, deprived of his senses, in that forest, never losing at any time the hope of continuing his life.”

sa: दश वर्षसहस्राणि दश वर्षशतानि च। पुष्करेष्ववसः कृष्ण त्वमपो भक्षयन् पुरा॥
en: O Krishna, living on water alone, you passed eleven thousand years in the days of yore by the side of the Pushkara (lake).

sa: उपसृष्टं तु तं कृष्णौ भ्राजमानं द्विजोत्तमम्। अर्जुनो वासुदेवश्च तूर्णमुत्पत्य तस्थतुः॥
en: Seeing that foremost of Brahmanas blazing with splendour coming towards them, Arjuna and Vasudeva hastily rose up and stood waiting (to receive command).

sa: तथा विक्षोभ्यमाणा सा पार्थेन तव वाहिनी। व्यशीर्यत महाराज नौरिवासाद्य पर्वतम्॥
en: Then, () monarch, your troops being thus agitated by the son of Pritha, was broken like a frail bark grounded on a rock.

sa: शिखण्डिनं तु समरे द्रोणप्रेप्सुं विशाम्पते। कृपः शारद्वतो यत्तः प्रत्यगच्छत् सवेगितः॥
en: Kripa, the son of Saradvata, rushed with great impetuosity and resoluteness, against the highly-powerful Sikhandi who was advancing in order to slay Drona.

sa: प्रामृगाच बहून् योधान् वायुर्वृक्षानिवौजसा। तं पुनः परिवव॒स्ते तव पुत्रा रथोत्तमम्॥
en: The mace then crushed Drona's chariot with his horses, charioteer and standard; then Bhima grinded numerous warriors, like the tempest crushing mighty trees.

sa: तदनार्यैः पुरा कृष्णां क्लिश्यमानामनागसम्। उपप्रेक्षसि राधेय क्व ते धर्मस्तदा गतः॥
en: O son of Radha! Where your religion (rule) was slipped when you once observed Draupadi getting torture in the hands of mean Kauravas.

sa: स शक्र इव विक्रान्तः शक्रसूनोः सुतो बली। अभिमन्युस्तदानीकं लोडयन् समदृश्यत॥
en: Endued with prowess equal to that of Shakra, that grandson of Shakra, namely Abhimanyu of infinite might, agitating your forces, appeared highly beautiful.

sa: युधामन्युश्च सम्प्राप्तो मत्वा तं रक्षसा हतम्॥ गदामुद्यम्य वेगेन हृदि द्रौणिमताडयत्।
en: Coming up and taking his comrade for being slain by a Rakshasa, Yudhamanyu speedily struck Drona's son in the chest with a mace.

sa: प्रतिलभ्य ततः संज्ञां नकुलः पाण्डुनन्दनः। अभ्ययात् सौबलं भूयो व्यात्तानन इवान्तकः॥
en: Then, Nakula, the son of Pandu, recovering his senses once again rushed against the son of Subala like death itself with gaping mouth.

sa: व्यधमत् तान् महावायुर्मेघानिव दुरत्ययः। ते हन्यमाना द्रोणेन पञ्चालाः प्राद्रवन् भयात्॥
en: Began, like a furious hurricane (chasing away) the clouds, to destroy his enemies. (Thus slaughter by Drona, the Panchalas fled away from terror.

sa: एवं विचरतस्तस्य निघ्नतः सुबहून् नरान्॥ तमसा रजनी घोरा बभौ दारुणदर्शना।
en: As Ashvatthaman moved about in this way killing thousands of men, the deep night became more dreadful for the darkness that set in.

sa: हाहाकारस्तथा दिक्षु सर्वेषां सुमहानभूत्। तज्ज्योतिः स्तूयमानं स्म ब्राह्मणं प्राविशत् तदा॥
en: Loud exclamations of sorrow, uttered by all creatures, were then heard on all sides. Lauded by all, that splendour then entered Brahmana's self.

sa: यच्च वै हृदि सर्वेषां दुःखमेतच्चिरं स्थितम्। तदद्य व्यपनेष्यामि परलोककृताद् भयात्॥
en: I shall today, dispel that sorrow which is in the hearts of you all, about the return of these to the other world.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नं चेदमाह भीमसेनो महाबलः। विदितं ते महाबाहो यथा द्रोणो महारथः॥
en: The puissant Bhima then addressing Dhrishtadyumna said these words. "O mightyarmed one, it is all known to you, that Drona the mighty car-warrior.

sa: गुणैर्भूतानि युज्यन्ते वियुज्यन्ते तथैव च। सर्वाणि नैतदेकस्य शोकस्थानं हि विद्यते॥
en: Creatures sometimes acquire and sometimes lose earthly objects. No man in this world can be grieved by all the events that befall him.

sa: तस्मिन् महापुण्यतमे त्रैलोक्यस्य सनातने। संग्रामे निधनं प्राप्य ध्रुवं स्वर्गे भविष्यति॥
en: He that breathes his last in battle on that eternal and most sacred of spots in the three worlds, will surely obtain heaven,

sa: हंस उवाच स्वाध्याय एषां देवत्वं व्रतं साधुत्वमुच्यते। असाधुत्वं परीवादो मृत्युर्मानुष्यमुच्यते॥
en: The Swan said The divinity of the Brahmanas consists in the study of the Vedas. Their purity is in their status of humanity?

sa: लब्धाहमपि तत्रैव वसता सव्यसाचिना। यथा त्वया जिता कृष्ण रुक्मिणी भीष्मकात्मजा।११५॥
en: O Krishna, as you have obtained Rukmani, the daughter of Bhishmaka, so Savyasachi (Arjuna) obtained me while he lived there (at Draupada's capital).

sa: राज्ञां मध्ये सभायां तु रजसातिपरिप्लुता। दृष्ट्वा च मांधार्तराष्ट्रा प्राहसन् पापचेतसः॥
en: Seeing me stained with blood (standing) in the presence of the kings in that assembly, the wicked-minded sons of Dhritarashtra laughed at me.

sa: ववौ सशर्करो वायुर्दिशश्च रजसा वृताः। हाहाकारश्च संजज्ञे सुराणां दिवि भारत॥
en: Violent winds blew scattering pebbles. All the directions were covered with dust and cries of lamentation arose amongst the celestials in the sky.

sa: अचरेभ्यश्च भूतेभ्यश्चराः श्रेष्ठाः सदा नराः। ब्राह्मणाश्च ततः श्रेष्ठास्तेषु यज्ञाः प्रतिष्ठिताः॥
en: Among all objects mobile and immobile, the mobile are superior. Among mobile creatures, Brahmanas are superior. The sacrifices are all set upon them.

sa: मुखतः सोऽग्निमसृजत् प्राणाद् वायुमथापि च। सरस्वती च वेदांश्च मनसः ससृजेऽच्युतः॥
en: He created Fire from his mouth, and wind from His vital breath. That undeteriorating One created Words and the Vedas from his mind.

sa: उवाच च महात्मानंधर्मराज युधिष्ठिरम्। ब्रूहिधर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठ केनार्थः किं ददानि ते॥
en: He thus spoke the high-souled Dharmaraja Yudhishthira, “O foremost of virtuous men, tell me what you seek and what I can give you."

sa: त्रयोविंशतिरात्रं यो योधयामास भार्गवम्। न च रामेण निस्तीर्णस्तमस्मि मनसा गतः॥
en: I was thinking of him who fought continually for twenty-three days with Rama himself of Bhrigu's race and whom Rama could not defeat.

sa: पुनः पुनर्न मृष्यामि विनाशममितौजसाम्॥ चिन्तयानो यदूनां च कृष्णस्य च यशस्विनः।
en: Thinking repeatedly of this destruction of the Yadava warriors of immeasurable energy and of the illustrious Krishna, I cannot get peace of mind.

sa: यदा सभायां राजानमनक्षज्ञं युधिष्ठिरम्। अजैषीच्छकुनि नात् क्व ते धर्मस्तदा गतः॥
en: When Shakuni, a clever hand at dice, defeated Kunit's son Yudhishthira who was innocent of the game where was this virtue of yours?

sa: तूर्णमाजजिरे हृष्टास्तावका जितकाशिनः। कृत्स्ना ह्यक्षौहिणी राजन् सव्यसाची च पाण्डवः।। ३४
en: Were quickly struck up by your troops when victory then appeared sure. The complete host of the Panavas and Sabyasachin himself O king.

sa: श्रान्तान् व्यस्तायुधान् सर्वान् क्षणेनैव व्यपोथयत्॥ योधानश्वान् द्विपांश्चैव प्राच्छिनत् स वरासिना।
en: With that excellent sword he cut off combatants and horses and elephants. bathed in blood, he appeared like dcah himself commissioned by them.

sa: नैव तस्य क्रतोरेष कलामर्हति षोडशीम्। एवं तत्रानुवन् केचिद् वातिकास्तं जनेश्वरम्॥
en: It does not come to the sixteenth part of that (sacrifice); thus spoke to that king some that were reckless in their speech.

sa: अपरे प्रद्रुता नागा भयत्रस्ता विशाम्पते। भ्रेमुर्दिशो यथा पूर्वं वने दावाग्निसंवृताः॥
en: Other huge elephants scorched with the burning heat fled and careered in fear in battlefield as if in a forest set on fire.

sa: ततो गाण्डीवधन्वा तु मागधेन भृशाहतः। बभौ वसन्तसमये पलाशः पुष्पितो यथा॥
en: The wielder of Gandiva, deeply struck by the king of Magadha, shone like a blossoming Palasha (Butea frondosa) in the season of spring.

sa: समीपे च महाबाहुपाचष्ट च मम प्रभो। कुरु कार्याणि कौन्तेय हयमेधार्थसिद्धये॥
en: powerful monarch, that agent of mine inforned me that the mighty-armed hero is very near to us. You begin to celebrate your Horse-Sacrifice.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा देवराजेन पत्नी सा कमलेक्षणा। एवमस्त्वित्यथोक्त्वा तु जगाम नहुषं प्रति॥
en: Being thus spoken to by the king of the gods his queen of lotus-like eyes, replied “Be it so" and went to Nahusha.

sa: यस्त्वं प्रच्यावितो राज्याद् व्यसनं चोत्तमं गतः। आनृशंस्येन वृत्तेन क्षत्रियेच्छसि जीवितुम्॥
en: I say this, O Kshatriya, because, though bereft of kingdom and plunged into great distress, still you wish to follow a pious course.

sa: नायं कालो विरोधस्य कौन्तेये समुपस्थिते। क्षन्तव्यं भवता सर्वमाचार्येण कृपेण च॥
en: When the son of Kunti has come it is not the time for dissension. Yourself and the preceptor and Kripa should forgive everything

sa: पञ्चालैनिहतौ वीरौ कच्चिन्नास्वपतां क्षितौ। कच्चित् ताभ्यां कृतं कर्म तन्ममाचक्ष्व संजय॥
en: Are those heroes, killed by the Panchalas, sleeping on the naked Earth? Did they perforin any feat? Tell me all this, O Sanjaya.

sa: तं तु तेनाभ्युपायेन गमयित्वा यमक्षयम्॥ अध्यतिष्ठत तेजस्वी रथं प्राप्य सुदर्शनम्।
en: Having sent him to Yamas abode by such means the greatly energetic, Ashvatthaman went out and getting upon his beautiful car waited there.

sa: श्रुत्वा तु मां कुशलिनमरोगं विगतज्वरम्। भविष्यति गुहः प्रीतः सममात्मसभः सखा॥
en: Hearing that I am hale and hearty and relieved of all troubles, Guha, my friend like my own self, shall attain to delight.

sa: स तदा राक्षसेन्द्रेण संदिष्टो रजनीचरः। शुको विहंगमो भूत्वा तूर्णमाप्लुत्य चाम्बरम्॥
en: And being thus commissioned by the lord of Rākşasas, that night-ranger assumed the shape of a bird and, bounding, speedily reached the sky.

sa: अथ लोकेश्वरोत्सृष्टा तब कालेन केन चित्। निद्रा समभवत्तीव्रा कुम्भकर्णस्य रूपिणी॥
en: Once upon a time in came to pass that, despatched by the lord of creatures, Steep in her (native) form powerfully overpowered Kumbhakarna.

sa: अराक्षसमिमं लोकं कर्तास्मि निशितैः शरैः। न चेच्छरणमभ्येषि तामादाय तु मैथिलीम्॥
en: I shall with my sharpened shafts render this world free from Rākşasas, unless rendering back Mitbila's daughter, you throw yourself on my mercy.

sa: यक्षाणां तु प्रहस्तेन सहस्रं निहतं रणे। महोदरेण चानिन्द्यं सहस्रमपरं हतम्।७॥
en: And a thousand of the Yakşas were slain by Praśasta in the conflict; and another thousand of capable warriors were slain by Mahodara.

sa: तस्य त्विदानीं श्रुत्वा मे वाक्यमेषा कृता मतिः। त्रौंल्लोकानपि जेष्यामि बाहुवीर्यमुपाश्रितः॥
en: But now hearing his (utterances), even this is my resolve. Depending upon the might of my arms, I shall conquer the three worlds.

sa: हस्वो रूक्षो प्रशस्तश्च परिवेषः सुलोहितः। आदित्यमण्डले नीलं लक्ष्म लक्ष्मण दृश्यते॥
en: O Laksmana, there is a crimson, rough, slight, and graceful rim round the Sun; and a blue mark is visible on his disc.

sa: वानराणां हि सा तीर्णा वाहिनी नलसेतुना। तीरे निविविशे राज्ञा बहुमूलफलोदके।॥
en: On the monkey-host having crossed by the bridge of Nala, the king stationed it on the shore abounding in fruits, roots, and water.

sa: कुम्भकर्णः प्रबुद्धोऽसौ भ्राता ते राक्षसेश्वर। कथं तत्रैव निर्यातु द्रक्ष्यसे तमिहागतम्॥
en: O lord of the Rākṣasas, your brother, Kumbhakarņa, has been roused. Shall he march from there; or will you see him come here?

sa: रथोद्वहनखिन्नाश्च भग्ना मे रथवाजिनः। दीना धर्मपरिश्रान्ता गावो वर्षहता इव ॥
en: The steeds of my car were worn out by-carrying it; and they were battered, and helpless and perspired like kine in a shower.

sa: वानरोद्धृष्टघोषश्च राक्षसानां च निःस्वनः। ज्याशब्दश्चापि रामस्य त्रयं व्याप दिशो दश।३८॥
en: The ululations of the monkeys and the cries of the Raksasas and the rattle of Rama's bowthese three filled the ten cardinal quarters.

sa: कल्याणै रुचिरं गात्रं परिष्वक्तं मयैव तु। क्रव्यादैस्तच्छरीरं ते नूनं विपरिकृष्यते॥
en: That person of your which, decked out with auspicious things, I used to embrace, beasts of prey will for certain tear the same.

sa: विराधश्च हतः संख्ये राक्षसो भीमविक्रमः। वने रामेण विक्रम्य महेन्द्रेणेव शम्बरः॥
en: For her (too) was destroyed in battle, the terribly powerful Rākşasa-Viradha, by Rāma putting forth his energy, like to ſambara killed by Mahendra.

sa: तैस्त्वं परिवृतः शूरैः शूलमुद्गरपाणिभिः। भवेस्त्वं संशयं प्राप्तो मया वीर कलत्रवान्॥
en: O hero, carrying me and encircled by those heroic Rākṣasas with maces and darts in their hands, you shall be beset with dangers.

sa: बहूनि नाम वर्षाणि गतस्य सुमहद्वनम्। शृणोम्यहं प्रीतिकरं मम नाथस्य कीर्तनम्॥
en: I hear the tidings of my brother affording me great delight who has been living in the huge forest for many a year.

sa: ततस्ते वानराः सर्वे शोणितौघपरिप्लुताः। ध्वजवर्मरथानश्वान्नानाप्रहरणानि च।। आप्लुत्याप्लुत्य समरे वानरेन्द्रा बभञ्जिरे॥
en: Being thus wounded and assailed by the Rākşasas, those heroic monkeys leaped and broke down the flags, armours, cars, horses and other weapons.

sa: एवं पितामहोक्तं च दशग्रीवस्य रक्षसः॥ अग्नौ हुतानि शीर्षाणि पुनस्तान्युत्थितानि वै।
en: As soon as the Ten-necked Rākṣasa had spoken, thus, the heads that had been offered as sacrifices into the fire, rose up again.

sa: समुत्तिष्ठन्तु ते सर्वे हता ये युधि राक्षसैः। ऋक्षाश्च सह गोपुच्छैनिकृत्ताननबाहवः॥
en: Let all those bears and Golangulas rise up who were slain in the conflict by Rákşasas and had their heads and arms severed.

sa: सा स्नापयन्ती विपुलौ स्तनौ नेत्रजलस्रवैः। चिन्तयन्ती न शोकस्य तदान्तमधिगच्छति। ७१३
en: With tears she bathed her beautiful breast and oppressed with woe, she could not reach the other bank of the ocean of grief.

sa: अहं हत्वा दशग्रीवं सप्रहस्तं सहात्मजम्। राजानं त्वां करिष्यामि सत्यमेतच्छृणोतु मे॥
en: Do you hear truly that I shall slay the Tennecked one together with Prahasta and his sons, and I shall make you king.

sa: सर्वो हि तपसा देव वृणोत्यमरतां पुमान्। विक्रमेण मया त्वेतदमरत्वं प्रवर्तितम्॥
en: All others, O god, attain to immortality by virtue of devout penances but I shall acquire that by dint of my own prowess.

sa: रावणेन प्रणिहितं तमवेहि निशाचरम्। तस्याहं निग्रहं मन्ये क्षमं क्षमवतां वर॥
en: O you the best of all forgiving persons, this night-ranger has been despatched by Rāvana. I therefore think it better to kill him.

sa: यस्मात्तु विश्रुतो वेदस्त्वयेहाध्ययतो मम। तस्मात्स विश्रवा नाम भविष्यति न संशयः॥
en: And as you had heard the Veda recited by me, so, without doubt, he shall be named Visravā.* *(From the root, Śru-to hear.)

sa: मुश्च मुञ्चते भाषन्तस्तिष्ठतिष्ठेति चासकृत्। मुसलानि च शूलानि सोत्ससर्ज तदा रणे॥
en: Thereupon exclaiming repeatedly “Leave him off! Leave him off Wait! Wait!!" The Raksasa host hurled hundreds of Musalas and darts in the battle-field.

sa: अहमेव सह भ्रात्रा लक्ष्मणेन महौजसा। आत्मना पञ्चमश्चायं सखा मम बिभीषणः॥
en: I along with my brother, the exceedingly energetic Lakşmaņa, and my friend Vibhīşaņa counting for the fifth in company with his own following.

sa: स संज्ञां प्राप्य तेजस्वी वालिपुत्रः प्रतापवान्। प्रजङ्घस्य शिरः कायात्पातयामास मुष्टिना॥
en: Then recovering his senses, the energetic and powerful son of Vālī by means of his clenched fist severed Prajangha's head from his body.

sa: अद्य गोमायुसङ्घाश्च श्येनसङ्घाश्च लक्ष्मण। गृध्राश्च निपतन्तु त्वां गतासुं निहतं मया॥
en: To-day, O Laksmana, swarms of jackals and hosts of hawks and vultures shall alight on you lying lifeless, having been slain by me.

sa: तस्य विस्फारघोषेण धनुषो महता दिशः। प्रदिशश्च नभश्चैव सहसा समपूर्यत ॥
en: The entire welkin, and all sides and quarters, were suddenly filled with the mighty sounds of that bow as it was being stretched.

sa: मयि दृष्टे तु रक्षोभी रामस्य विदितात्मनः। भवेद् व्यर्थमिदं कार्यं रावणानर्थमिच्छतः॥
en: On my being seen by the Rākşasas, the work of Rāma cognizant of self, desirous of the destruction of Ravana, shall be marred.

sa: मणिरत्नं कपिवरः प्रतिगृह्याभिवाद्य च। सीतां प्रदक्षिणं कृत्वा प्रणतः पार्श्वतः स्थितः॥
en: And taking the gem, and bowing to Sītā and going round her, that foremost of monkeys remained by her side in humble guise.

sa: एतान्सर्वान्वरांल्लब्ध्वा पुत्रस्तेऽयं दशानन । अद्य यज्ञसमाप्तौ च त्वां दिदृक्षन्स्थितो ह्यहम्॥
en: Having obtained these boons your son, O you having ten faces, and myself, the sacrifice being finished, have been waiting to behold you.

sa: जनस्थाने हतस्थाने निहते रक्षसां बले। अशक्तेन त्वया रक्षः कृतमेतदसाधु वै॥
en: Janasthāna has been devastated, the host of Rākṣasas has been killed, and you had been disabled. Truly you had perpetrated an impious deed.

sa: मानुषे मानुषस्यैव भार्यात्वं बहु मन्यसे। प्रत्याहर मनो रामानैवं जातु भविष्यति॥
en: O woman, you regardest highly to be the wife of a man. Do you turn back from Rāma-your desire shall never be satisfied.

sa: तथापि तु नयज्ञेन जयमाकाङ्क्षता रणे॥ आत्मा रक्ष्यः प्रयत्नेन युद्धसिद्धिर्हि चञ्चला।
en: Still a person versed in polity, albeit anxious to secure victory in battle, should carefully preserve self, as success in war is unstable.

sa: तस्याश्रमपदस्थस्य बुद्धिर्जज्ञे महात्मनः। चरिष्ये परमं धर्म धर्मो हि परमा गतिः॥
en: And as he was staying in the hermitage, that high-souled one thought, 'I shall practice prime righteousness: verily virtue is the supreme way.'

sa: आह त्वां राघवो रामः कौसल्यानन्दवर्धनः। निष्पत्य प्रतियुध्यस्व नृशंस पुरुषो भव॥
en: Raghu's son, Rāma-enhancer of Kausaiya's joy-has said to you, 'Do you, O fell one, coming out, give me battle and prove your prowess.

sa: किंचिद्वक्ष्यामि तावत्तु श्रोतव्यं श्रोष्यसे यदि। तन्मे निगदतस्तात समाधिं श्रवणे कुरु॥
en: I will tell you something. If you would hear what I have to say then, O child, listen heedfully as I unfold it.

sa: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु यथाकामं च राघव। नर्मदा नाम गन्धर्वी बभूव रघुनन्दन ॥ तस्याः कन्यात्रयं ह्यासीद्धीश्रीकिर्तिसमद्युति। ज्येष्ठक्रमेण सा तेषां राक्षसानामराक्षसी॥ कन्यास्ताः प्रददौ हृष्टा पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाः।
en: At this time, O Rāghava, there lived at her pleasure a Gandharvi, named Narmadā. O son of Raghu, She hai three daughters, resembling Sri, Hri, and kirti in splendour. And albeit no Rāks asi herself, she, beginning with the eldest, gladly married to the Räkşasas her daughter having faces resembling the full moon.

sa: एते वयमनुप्राप्ताः सुग्रीव वरुणालयम्। इहेदानी विचिन्ता सा या नः पूर्वमुपस्थिता॥
en: O Sugrīva we have arrived at the abode of Varuņa. Now has arisen in my mind what I had not thought of before.

sa: कपोता रक्तपादाच सारिका विदुता ययुः॥ काका वाश्यन्ति तत्रैव बिडालाय द्विपादिकाः।
en: And blood-footed pigeons and Sarikas* darted off (around). And crows and two-legged cats began to cry in loud accents. *A species of harlot.

sa: उपवासकृशां दीनां कामरूप निशाचर। संतापयसि मां भूयः संतापं तत्र शोभनम्॥
en: O night-ranger, O you wearing shapes at will! it dose not behove you to distress me who am poorly and famished with fasts.

sa: जीवितं त्यक्तुमिच्छामि शोकेन महता वृता। राक्षसीभिश्च रक्षन्त्या रामो नासाद्यते मया॥
en: I wish to renounce my life under this load of grief-but alas! I am surrounded by the Raks asis and cannot meet Rāma.

sa: अशक्नुवन्तस्ते विष्णुं प्रतियोद्धं बलार्दिताः। त्यक्त्वा लङ्कां गता वस्तुं पातालं सहपत्नयः॥
en: And albeit inflated with pride, they, incapable of coping with Vişnu, leaving Lankā, went to the nether regions with their wives dwelling there.

sa: विभीषणस्य चैश्वर्यं भविष्यति हते त्वयि। न चेत्सत्कृत्य वैदेही प्रणिपत्य प्रदास्यसि॥
en: On you being slain, all the wealth shall be Vibhisana's; unless, bowing down (to me) and paying me homage, you render back Maithilī.

sa: अङ्गदप्रमुखैवीरैर्हतं मधुवनं किल॥ विचित्य दक्षिणामाशामागतैर्हरिपुङ्गवैः। आगतैश्च प्रहृष्टं तद्यथा मधुवनं हि तैः॥ धर्षितं च वनं कृत्स्नमुपयुक्तं तु वानरैः। पातिता वनपालास्ते तदा जानुभिराहताः॥ एतदर्थमयं प्राप्तो वक्तुं मधुरवागिह। नाम्ना दधिमुखो नाम हरिः प्रख्यातविक्रमः॥
en: Forsooth that orchard has been laid waste by these heroes headed by Angada. And ransacking the southern quarter, those leading monkeys have come back and delightedly entered the Madhuvana. And the whole orchard has been explored and enjoyed by those monkeys and the attendants beaten and wounded on their kneejoints. To communicate to me this intelligence, this monkey of known prowess, and sweet accents, named Dhadimukha, has come here.

sa: अभवत्सुदिने काले दुर्दिनं रूक्षमारुतम्॥ ऊचुः खगमृगाः सर्वे वाचः क्रूरा भयावहाः।
en: In a fair day, it looked foul with the wind breathing roughly. And fierce and frightful beasts and birds began to emit cries.

sa: उपवासेन शोकेन ध्यानेन च भयेन च। परिक्षीणां कृशां दीनामल्पाहारां तपोधनाम्॥
en: With fasts and grief, anxiety and fear, she was greatly weakened and reduced and gave up cating and took recourse to asceticism only.

sa: प्रक्षीणं स्वबलं दृष्ट्वा बध्यमानं बलीमुखैः। बभूवास्य व्यथा युद्धे दृष्ट्वा दैवविपर्ययम्॥
en: Observing his army reduced and slain by the heroic (monkeys) he perceived ill omens in the fight and was accordingly pained at heart,

sa: चालयन्तं महासैन्यं विधमन्तं महारथान्। ददृशुस्तेन वै रामं वातं वनगतं यथा॥
en: Except when guiding the huge army or driving the cars they could not see Rama like to the wind invisible in a forest.

sa: पितुर्निदेशं नियमेन कृत्वा वनान्निवृत्तश्चरितव्रतश्च। स्त्रीभिस्तु मन्ये विपुलेक्षणाभिः संरंस्यसे वीतभयः कृतार्थः॥
en: And duly satisfying your sire's command, and returning successfully from the forest, you shall fearlessly sport with many a damsel having large eyes.

sa: राजन् धर्मविरुद्धं च लोकवृत्तेश्च गर्हितम्। तव चासदृशं वीर कपेरस्य प्रमापणम्॥
en: The taking the monkey's life, O king, is opposed to morality and repugnant to social usage; and it is also unworthy of yourself.

sa: अद्य देवगणाः सर्वे लोकपाला महर्षयः। हतमिन्द्रजितं दृष्ट्वा सुखं स्वप्स्यन्ति निर्भयाः॥
en: To-day seeing Indrajit slain, the deities and the guardians of the worlds, and the mighty saints, their fear gone off, shall sleep peacefully.

sa: न च शक्ष्ये त्वया सार्धं गन्तुं शत्रुविनाशन। कलत्रवति संदेहस्त्वयि स्यादप्यसंशयम्॥
en: O slayer of foes, I shall not be able to accompany you. For seeing you carry a woman, they shall surely suspect you.

sa: कामं त्विदानीमपि मां व्यादिश त्वं परंतप। न परः प्रेक्षणीयस्ते युद्धायातुलविक्रम॥
en: O repressor of foes, do you now command me O you of unparalleled prowess, you need not yourself face the foe in fight.

sa: एतद्विस्तारतः सर्वं कथयस्व ममानघ । कुतूहलमिदं मह्यं नुद भानुर्यथा तमः।७।।
en: All this, O sinless one, do you tell me in detail, and do you dispel my curiosity even as the sun dispels darkness.

sa: तथा निगमवृद्धाश्च कुलीना ये च मानवाः। शिरसा वन्द्य राजानमुपासन्ते विचक्षणाः॥
en: All those who were advanced in the study of Vedas, born in respectable families, and learned, bowed to the king lowering their heads.

sa: एवमुक्ताब्रवीद्रम्भा वेपमाना कृताञ्जलिः। प्रसीद नार्हसे वक्तुमीदृशं त्वं हि मे गुरुः॥
en: Being thus addressed, Rambhā, trembling, with folded palms, said:-Be you propitiated; it does not behave you to speak thus, who are my superior.

sa: कृतं कर्म महत् तेन मां तथाभ्यवपद्यता। तिष्ठता रावणवधे वृद्धेनापि जटायुषा॥
en: O great was the work done by him, who, old as he was, for my sake, addressed himself to bring about Rāvana's destruction.

sa: ते महामेघसंकाशे कवचे पातिताः शराः। अवध्ये राक्षसेन्द्रस्य न व्यथां जनयंस्तदा॥
en: Alighting at the impenetrable mail of the Rākşasa-chief, resembling a mass of mighty clouds, those arrows did not then occasion him any pain.

sa: यत्तैश्च खलु भाव्यं स्यात् तमासाद्य वनालयम्। कर्म चापि समाधेयं देशकालाविरोधितम्॥
en: And coming to that dweller of the woods, youhad better act heedfully, and should accomplish this work in consonance with place and season.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा तु संक्रुद्धो निःश्वसन्नुरगो यथा। अब्रवीद्रक्षसां मध्ये धूम्राक्षं नाम राक्षसम्॥
en: Having said this in high rage Rāvana, sighing like a serpent, addressed a Raksasa, named Dhūmrākṣa, seated in the midst of the Rākşasa.

sa: महोदरोऽयं रामात्तु एष निर्याम्यहं युद्धमुद्यतः शत्रुनिर्जये। दुर्नयं भवतामद्य समीकर्तुं महाहवे।।।।।
en: For repairing in mighty conflict the wrong that you have perpetrated, I am about to set out for battle for routing the enemy.

sa: ब्रह्माणं वरदं ज्ञात्वा सेन्ट्रैर्देवगणैर्वृतम्। ऊचुः प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे वेपमाना इव दुमाः॥
en: Knowing that Brahmā surrounded by Indra and the other celestials was ready to bestow boons, they, with joined hands, said, trembling like trees.

sa: प्रणिधाय हि चारेण यथावत्सूक्ष्मबुद्धिना। परीक्ष्य च ततः कार्यों यथान्यायं परिग्रहः॥
en: If did you, sounding him well through the instrumentality of sharp spies, find him friendly, do you win him over to your side.

sa: स तं यदा परिश्रान्तमिन्द्रं जज्ञेऽथ रावणिः। तदैनं मायया बद्ध्वा स्वसैन्यमभितोऽनयत्॥
en: When Råvaņa's son came to know that Indra was exhausted he, having bound him up by virtue of illusion, proceeded towards his army.

sa: एवं निरयगामी त्वं यस्य ते मतिरीदृशी। न त्वां समभिभाषिष्येसद्वत्तेष्वेष निर्णयः॥
en: Being given to such iniquitous acts, you will go to hell; and your designs being such, I will not hold parley with you.

sa: राक्षसाधिपते सौम्य नित्यं मद्विजये रत। वैदेही संनिकर्ष मे क्षिप्रं समभिगच्छतु॥
en: O lord of Rakşasas, O gentle (king) O you ever engaged in encompassing my success, do you speedily bring Vaidehī nearer to me.

sa: यमो दण्डादवध्यत्वमरोगत्वं च दत्तवान्। वरं ददामि संतुष्ट अविषादं च संयुगे॥
en: Yama granted invulnerability to his Danda and diseases. The Kuber told he will ever remain happy and satisfied even at the time adversary.

sa: दिग्गजानां च तच्छ्रुत्वा देवता: पितरस्तथा। ऋषयश्च महाभागाः पूजयन्ति स्म रेणुकम्॥
en: Hearing these words of the powerful clephants, the celestials and the departed Manes and the highly blessed Rishis, all spoke highly of Renuka.

sa: यथा च दीपः शरणे दीप्यमानः प्रकाशते। एवमेव शरीराणि प्रकाशयति चेतना॥
en: As a lamp, burning in a room, discovers (all things within it), so does the mind discover the different limbs of the body.

sa: धरण्या निष्क्रयं दत्त्वा तद्धिरण्यं युधिष्ठिरः॥ धूतपापो जितस्वर्गो मुमुदे भ्रातृभिः सह।
en: Having paid that wealth as the price of the Earth, Yudhishthira, purged of his sins and assured of Heaven, rejoiced with his brothers.

sa: भूमिपालं च्युतं राष्ट्राद् यस्तु संस्थापयेन्नरः। तस्य वासः सहस्राक्ष नाकपृष्ठे महीयते॥
en: That man who reinstates a king driven away from his kingdom, gets residence in Heaven and is much honoured by the denizens thereof.

sa: सर्वत्र विजयं चापि लभते मनुजाधिप॥ अमृतं वै गवां क्षीरमित्याह त्रिदशाधिपः।
en: Such a person, O king, wins victory everywhere. The very king of the celestials had said that the milk of kine is nectar.

sa: द्विविधो हि स्मृतो गन्ध इष्टोऽनिष्टश्च पुष्पजः। इष्टगन्धानि देवानां पुष्पाणीति विभावय॥
en: The scent of flowers is of two kinds, agreeable and disagreeable. Those flowers which have sweet smell should be offered to the celestials.

sa: ततस्तस्मिन् दिवं याते नृगे भरतसत्तम। वासुदेव इमं श्लोकं जगाद कुरुनन्दन॥
en: After Nriga had thus proceeded to the celestial region, O best of the Bharatas, Vasudeva recited this Verse, O delighter, of the Kurus.

sa: इदं तु पुरुषव्याघ्र पुरस्ताच्छुतवानहम्॥ यथा रक्षा कृता पूर्वं विपुलेन गुरुस्त्रियाः।
en: This, O chief of men, I heard in former days viz., how Vipula had succeeded in protecting his preceptor's wife in ancient times.

sa: तु यस्य वै शैशिरे काले तडागे सलिलं भवेत्। तस्याग्निष्टोमयज्ञस्य फलमाहुर्मनीषिणः॥
en: That person in whose tank water lies in the season of dew, acquires, the wise have said, the merits of an Agnishtoma sacrifice.

sa: एतां बुद्धिं विनिश्चित्य भूतानामागतिं गतिम्। पितृपैतामहे वृत्ते शाधि राज्यं यथोचितम्॥
en: And knowing this wisdom and the destiny of all creatures, and following the conduct of your forefathers do you duly govern your kingdom.

sa: धर्मराजश्च पुत्रस्ते राज्यं प्राणान् धनानि च। अनुजानाति राजर्षे यच्चान्यदपि किंचन॥
en: Your son, king Yudhishthira, too, offers you, O royal sage, his kingdom and life-breaths and riches and all else which belongs to him.

sa: हतप्रवीरां पृथिवी हृतरत्नां च भारत। सदैव चिन्तयन्तस्ते न शर्म चोपलेभिरे॥
en: They could not get peace of mind upon repeatedly thinking that the Earth had become divested of both her heroes and her riches.

sa: निदाघकाले पानीयं यस्य तिष्ठत्यवारितम्। स दुर्गं विषमं कृत्स्नं न कदाचिदवाप्नुते॥
en: That man gets over every sort of calamity from whose well or tank every one draws water without restraint during the summers season.

sa: स वर्द्धमानद्वारेण निर्ययौ गजसाह्वयात्। विसर्जयामास च तं जनौघं स मुहुर्मुहुः॥
en: He left the city of Hastinapur by the principal gate, and then repeatedly asked that crowd of people to return to their homes.

sa: श्रुत्वाभिमन्योस्तनयं जातं च मृतमेव च। मुषिता इव वार्ष्णेय द्रोणपुत्रेण पाण्डवाः॥
en: Hearing that Abhimanyu's son was born and dead, the Pandavas, O you of Vrishni's race, will consider themselves as imposed upon by Ashvatthaman.

sa: कच्चित् पाण्डुसुताः पच्च धृतराष्ट्रस्य चात्मजाः। लोकेषु विहरिष्यन्ति त्वया सह परंतप॥
en: Will the five sons of Pandu, and the children of Dhritarashtra, o destroyer of enemies, sport in the world in joy with you?

sa: स प्रविश्य पुरी दीनो नाभ्यभाषत किंचन। तदेव चिन्तयामास च्यवनस्य विचेष्टितम्॥
en: Entering his mansion in a dejected spirit, The spoke not a word with any one. He thought only of that conduct of Chyavana.

sa: भवान् सृजति भूतानि भवान् संहरति प्रजाः। प्रकृतिः सर्वभूतानां समानां सनातनी॥
en: It is you who create all creatures and it is you who destroy them. You are the eternal nature of all transitory things.

sa: तस्माच्छोकं कुरुश्रेष्ठ जहि त्वमरिकर्शन। विचार्यमत्र न हि ते सत्यमेतद् भविष्यति॥
en: Therefore, O foremost one of Kuru's race, renounce this grief, O mower of enemies! Do not doubt this! This will truly take place.

sa: निर्ममो निरहङ्कारो निराशी: सर्वतः समः। अकामभूत इत्येव सतां धर्मः सनातनः॥
en: Freedom from cgoism, freedom from expectations, loO king on all impartially, and freedom from desire, these form the cternal religion of the good.

sa: श्रद्धया परया यस्त्वं तपश्चरसि सुव्रत॥ तस्माद् देवाश्च दानेन प्रीता ब्राह्मणसत्तम।
en: you of excellent vows, you practice penances with great devotion. Your gifts have, therefore, pleased the deities highly, O best of twice-borm ones.

sa: अभ्यद्रवन्त देवांस्ते सहस्राणि दशैव हि। ततस्तैरर्दिता देवाः शरणं वासवं ययुः॥
en: They then ran against the celestials numbering ten thousand. Afflicted by the Danavas, the gods then sought the refuge of their king Vasava.

sa: तस्य प्रयाणे यान्यासन् निमित्तानि महात्मनः। बहून्यद्भुतरूपाणि तानि मे गदतः शृणु॥
en: The marks which were displayed on the occasion of the great one's departure, I shall now fully describe. Do you listen to me.

sa: न हि शान्तिं प्रपश्यामि पातयित्वा पितामहम्॥ कर्णं च पुरुषव्याघ्र संग्रामेष्वपलायिनम्।
en: After having killed my grandfather, and that foremost of men, Karna, who never fled from the field of battle, I find no peace.

sa: विदुरश्च महाप्राज्ञो ययौ सिद्धिं तपोबलात्। धृतराष्ट्रः समासाद्य व्यासं चैव तपस्विनम्॥
en: ighly wise Vidura acquired great success through the power of his penances. Dhritarashtra also acquired great success for having inet the ascetic Vyasa.

sa: यावदेतान् पुनः सुभ्र क्षिपामीति जनाधिए। सा गच्छन्त्यन्तरा छायां वृक्षमाश्रित्य भामिनी॥ तस्थौ तस्या हि सन्तप्तं शिरः पादौ तथैव च। स्थिता सा तु मुहूर्तं वै भर्तुः शापभयाच्छुभा॥ ययावानयितुं भूयः सायकानसितेक्षणा। प्रत्याजगाम च शरांस्तानादाय यशस्विनी॥ सा वै खिन्ना सुचार्वङ्गी पद्भ्यां दुःखं नियच्छती। उपाजगाम भर्तारं भयाद् भर्तुः प्रवेपती॥
en: O you of beautiful eyebrows, I shall again shoot them with my bow! The lady proceeded on her errand but was compelled to sit under the shade of a tree, on account of her head and feet being scorched by the heat of the Sun. The black eyed and graceful Renuka, having rested for only a moment, feared the curse of her husband and, therefore began to collect and bring back the arrows. Taking them with her, the celebrated lady of beautiful features came back, distressed in mind and her feet smarting with pain. Trembling with fear, she approached her husband.

sa: श्येन उवाच न वराहं न चोक्षाणं न चान्यान् विविधान् द्विजान्। भक्षयामि महाराज किमन्यायेन तेन मे॥ यस्तु मे विहितो भक्ष्यः स्वयं देवैः सनातनः। श्येनाः कपोतान् खादन्ति स्थितिरेषा सनातनी॥
en: The hawk said I do not, O king, eat the flesh of the boar or the ox or of any of the various kinds of fowl. What need have I of food of this or that kind? My business is with that food which has been eternally ordained for beings of my order? Hawks feed on pigeons. This is the eternal ordinance.

sa: श्रुतमाप्नोति हि नरः सततं वृद्धसेवया॥ स्वाध्याय भोजने चैव दक्षिणं पाणिमुद्धरेत्।
en: One acquires wisdom by constantly waiting upon the aged. While reading the Vedas or employed in eating, one should use his right hand.

sa: न च प्रतिनिधि कर्तुं चिकीर्षामि तपोधन। भगवन् सम्यक् साचिव्यं कर्तुमर्हसि॥
en: Nor, O ascetic, do I like to have a substitute. In this matter, O reverend sir, you should favour me with your advice.

sa: खनीनेत्रस्तु विक्रान्तो जित्वा राज्यमकण्टकम्। नाशकद् रक्षितुं राज्यं नान्वरज्यन्त तं प्रजाः॥
en: And having conquered the entire kingdom shorn of all troubles, Khaninetra, could not retain his supremacy; nor were the people satisfied with him.

sa: सा त्वं मयि मृते मातस्तथा गाण्डीवधन्वनि। भव प्रीतिमती देवि सत्येनात्मानमालभे॥
en: Be happy today, O mother, seeing myself and the wielder of Gandiva both, embrace death today. I swear to you by truth itself.

sa: इत्युक्तः स द्विजश्रेष्ठो व्यासशिष्यः प्रतापवान्। प्रोवाच वदतां श्रेष्ठस्तं नृपं जनमेजयम्॥
en: Thus asked, that foremost of twice-born persons, viz., the disciple of Vyasa, that first of speakers, possessed of great energy, thus answered Janamejaya.

sa: कौतूहलं मे सुमहज्जामदग्न्यं प्रति प्रभो। रामं धर्मभृतां श्रेष्ठं तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हसि॥
en: I have a great curiosity about Jamadagni's son, O lord, viz., Rama, that foremost of all pious persons. you should satisfy that curiosity.

sa: स मुहूर्तं समाश्वस्य सह देव्या महाद्युतिः। पुनरन्वेषणे यत्नमकरोत् परमं तदा॥
en: Comforted. he up soon, and accompanied by his queen, the king possessed of great splendour, began to search everywhere for the Rishi. rose

sa: पुत्र संशाम्यतां तावन्ममापि बलवाश्रमः। इत्युक्त्वा प्राविशद् राजा गान्धार्या भवनं तदा॥
en: And he said, 'Cease, O son. I have been। tired greatly.' Having said these words, the old king entered the apartments of Gandhari.

sa: तत्रैकस्तूर्णमगमत् तत्पदे च विवर्तयन्। एकस्तु न तदा राजश्चक्रतुः कलहं ततः॥
en: One of them made a rapid step and thereby destroyed the cadence of the movement. Therefore, O king, a dispute arose between them.

sa: मांसप्रतिग्रहे चैव मधुनो लवणस्य च। आदित्योदयनं स्थित्वा पूतो भवति ब्राह्मणः॥
en: In accepting meat, or honey, or salt, a Brahmana becomes purged off of all sins by standing till the rising of the Sun.

sa: अन्वयुः पाण्डवास्तां तु सभृत्यान्तः पुरास्तथा। तत: प्रमृज्य साश्रूणि पुत्रान् वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: The Pandavas, with all their wives and servitors, continued to follow her. Restraining then her tears, she addressed her children in these words.

sa: नारदस्य वचः श्रुत्वा क्रुद्धः प्राज्वलदाङ्गिराः। अपिबत् तेजसा वारि विष्टभ्य सुमहातपाः॥
en: Hearing these words of Narada, Angirasa became enraged. Having penances for wealth, he solidified the waters and drank them off, by his energy.

sa: नारद उवाच उन्मत्तवेषं विभ्रत् स चक्रमीति यथासुखम्। वाराणस्यां महाराज दर्शनेप्सुर्महेश्वरम्॥
en: Narada said Desirous of seeing Maheshvara, O prince, he roves about at his pleasure in the city of Varanasi dressed as a maniac.

sa: ततः समेत्य नकुलं पर्यपृच्छन्त ते द्विजाः। कुतस्त्वं समनुप्राप्तो यज्ञं साधुसमागमम्॥
en: Approaching the mongoose, they then asked him, saying, 'Whence have you come to this sacrifice this resort of the good and the pious?

sa: विदुरः संजयश्चैव ययुत्सुश्चैव कौरव। उपासते स्म तु वृद्धं हतपुत्रं जनाधिपम्॥
en: Vidura, Sanjaya, and Yuyutsu, O you of Kuru's race, used to always wait upon the old king whose sons had all been killed.

sa: अग्नि देवताः सर्वा इति देवस्य शासनम्। संजायते ब्राह्मणस्य ज्ञानं बुद्धिसमन्वितम्॥
en: Agni (fire) is all the celestials. This is the teaching of the Veda, The knowledge of Agni arises in a Brahmana, with intelligence,

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तान् समीपगताश्रुत्वा पाण्डवान् शत्रुकर्शनः। वासुदेवः सहामात्यः प्रययौ ससुहृद्गणः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Hearing that the Pandavas were near, that destroyer of enemies, viz., Vasudeva, accompanicd by his ministers, went out for seeing them.

sa: वाचके परितुष्टे तु शुभा प्रतिरनुत्तमा। ब्राह्मणेषु तु तुष्टेषु प्रसन्नाः सर्वदेवताः॥
en: The reciter being satisfied the house holder acquiring excellent and auspicious contentment. It the Brahmanas are satisfied all the deities are gratified. an

sa: सोऽश्वमेधेश्वरं राजन् रोचमानं सहानुगम्। जिगाय समरे वीरो बलेन बलिनां वरः॥
en: O king, that hero, the foremost of all mighty men, then defeated in battle Rochaman, the king of Ashvamedha, with all his troops.

sa: सरीसृपाश्च बहवो बहुरूपाश्च भामिनि। चरन्ति पथि ते दात्ततो दुःखतरं वनम्॥
en: Reptiles, many and of various kinds, creep there on the path, O excellent lady, with haughtiness; so the wood is full of misery.

sa: रात्रिंचराणां सत्त्वानां निर्घोषोऽभूत् सुदारुणः। क्रव्यादाश्च प्रमुदिता घोरा प्राप्ता च शर्वरी॥
en: The night-ranging animals set up a dreadful noise. The carnivorous creatures were full of joy, and the night, as it advanced, became awful.

sa: व्यास उवाच पद्मयोनिवचः श्रुत्वा ततः प्रीतो महेश्वरः। प्रसादाभिमुखो भूत्वा अट्टहासमथाकरोत्॥
en: Vyasa said Hearing the words of the lotus-sprung Divinity, Maheswara then became propitiated and desirous of showering his grace, he then laughed aloud.

sa: उत्तङ्क उवाच अन्यस्मिन्करणीये तु कार्ये पार्थिवसत्तम। बाल्यादिवान्यदेव तवं कुरुषे नृपसत्तम॥
en: Uttanka said: O best of kings, you are spending your time like a child when a most important matter urgently demands your attention.

sa: एवं चैतत् करिष्यामि यथा मामनुशाससि। सुप्रभातामिमां रात्रिं जयाय विजयस्य हि॥
en: I shall do what you will bid me do. This night will end ushering in a morning, that will bring victory for Vijaya.

sa: तत्र काकसहस्राणि तां निशां पर्यणामयन्। सुखं स्वपन्ति कौरव्य पृथक् पृथगुपाश्रयाः॥
en: On that banian thousands of crows roosted in the night. Each perching separately from its neighbour, those crows slept easily, O Kuru Chief.

sa: न ब्राह्मणानां कोपोऽस्ति कुतः कोपाच्च यातनाम्। मार्दवारक्षम्यतां साधो मुच्यतामेष पन्नगः॥
en: Brahmanas do not cherish resentment, because resentment leads to pain. Do you, O Goodman, forgive and set free this serpent out of mercy.

sa: स दृष्ट्वा विमलं तोयं सारसैः परिवारितम्। पातुकामस्ततो वाचमन्तरिक्षात् स शुश्रुवे॥
en: And seeing the transparent water surrounded by cranes, as he was desirous of drinking of it, he heard these words from the firmament.

sa: ततोऽब्रवीत् सत्यधृतिः कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। गच्छ सौम्य ततः शीघ्रं तूणैः पानीयमानय॥
en: Thereupon, Yudhishthira, the son of Kunti, firm in truth, said "O beautiful one, do go (there) and soon bring water in the quivers."

sa: चिक्षिपुस्तानि शूलानि राघवं प्रति दुर्जयम्। तानि शूलानि काकुत्स्थः समस्तानि चतुर्दश॥
en: And discharged darts at the invincible Rāghava. Thereupon Kākutstha by means of shafts decked with gold, cut off those fourteen darts of theirs.

sa: ततः स पृथिवीपालो लिखितस्य महात्मनः। करौ प्रच्छेदयामास धृतदण्डो जगाम सः॥
en: Then that king caused the two hands of the high-souled Likhita to be cut off, whereupon the latter, bearing the punishment, went away.

sa: अतक्षेतत् प्रजानन्ति प्रभासमिति भूमिप। प्रभां हि परमां लेभे तस्मिन्नुन्मज्ज्य चन्द्रमाः॥
en: O lord of Earth, that tirtha is known by the name of Prabhasa, because bathing there the moon regained his great (Prabha) effulgence.

sa: इहैकस्थं जगत् कृत्स्नं पश्याद्य सचराचरम्। मम देहे गुडाकेश यच्चान्यद् द्रष्टुमिच्छसि॥
en: Behold, Gudakesha, the entire universe of movable and immovable and whatever else you wish to see, all collected together in my this body.

sa: भवाप्ययौ हि भूतानां श्रुतौ विस्तरशो मया। त्वत्तः कमलपत्राक्ष माहात्म्यमपि चाव्ययम्॥
en: O lotus-eyed one, I have heard elaborately from you the mystery of production and dissolution of things, and also about your inexhaustible greatness.

sa: सा तथोक्ता तु वैदेही निर्भया शोककर्शिता। तृणमन्तरतः कृत्वा रावणं प्रत्यभाषत॥
en: Having been thus addressed, Vaidehī unaffected by fear, although exercised with grief, placing a blade of grass between herself and Rāvana, answered him.

sa: गावश्च सम्प्रतिष्ठाप्य सेनां व्यूह्य समन्ततः। आरक्षाश्च विधीयन्तां यत्र योत्स्यामहे परान्॥
en: Keeping the kine secure arrange the army in battle array. Keep guards in proper places so that we may fight with the enemy.

sa: तमुवागम्य विप्रः स हर्यश्वं गालवोऽब्रवीत्। कन्येयं मम राजेन्द्र प्रसवैः कुलवर्धिनी॥
en: Who desirous of the peace of his subjects was practicing excellent austerities. The regenerate Rishi Galava, Having approached him, Haryashva, said to him:

sa: अनिवृत्ते तु निर्वासे यदि बीभत्सुरागतः। पुनादश वर्षाणि वने वत्स्यन्ति पाण्डवाः॥
en: Now if Bibhatsu comes before the term of exile is over, the Pandavas shall have to pass another twelve years in the forest.

sa: भगवान् कारणं कार्य क्रिया करणमेव च। असतश्च सतश्चैव तथैव प्रभवाप्ययौ॥
en: You, O illustrious one, are Cause and Effect and Action and Instrument of everything unreal and real, and you are Creation and Destruction.

sa: परस्परस्य सुहृदो भावयन्तः परस्परम्। स्वस्ति ब्रजत भद्रं वो धारयध्वं परस्परम्॥
en: Becoming friendly to one another, and pleasing one another, depart in depart in peace. Blessings to you, do you up hold one another.

sa: आदित्यकेतोः केतुं च छित्त्वा बाणेन संयुगे। भल्लेन भृशतीक्ष्णेन शिरश्चिच्छेद भारत॥
en: Severing the umbrella of Adityaketu with a shaft, Bhima cut down the former's head, O Bharata, with a broad-headed arrow of exceeding sharpness.

sa: पुनाति गमनादेव दृष्टमेकं नराधिप। केशानभ्युक्ष्य वै तस्मिन् पूतो भवति भारत॥
en: O ruler of men, man obtains virtue by only going there. O descendant of Bharata, shaving there one's hair, a man becomes sanctified.

sa: एकस्य मरणं मेऽस्तु मा भूत्सर्वविनाशनम्। इति बुद्ध्या विनिश्चित्य राघवाय न्यवेदयत्॥
en: My own destruction is far more desirable than that of all. Having thus resolved Lakşmaņa approached Rāma and communicated to him the intelligence.

sa: एतां बुद्धिं समास्थाय मङ्किनिर्वेदमागतः। सर्वान् कामान् परित्यज्य प्राप्य ब्रह्म महत्सुखम्॥
en: Putting his faith upon such, intelligence, Manki succeeded in freeing himself from attachments, by his self-renunciation and obtained the blissful region of Brahma.

sa: एतस्मिन्नन्तरे देवः सहस्राक्षः शचीपतिः॥ आसमाद वनस्थां तां वचनं चेदमब्रवीत् ।
en: In the meanwhile, that god, the thousand-eyed lord of Śacī went to (Sītā) staying in the woods, and spoke to her these words,

sa: रामस्य तु विशालाक्षी पूर्णेन्दुसदृशानना। धर्मपत्नी प्रिया नित्यं भर्तुः प्रियहिते रता॥
en: And Rāma's virtuously wedded beloved wife having expansive eyes, and a face resembling the full-moon, is ever to the welfare of her lord.

sa: यता हि शैशिरः कालो गवां मर्माणि कृन्तति। तथा पाण्डुसुतानां वै भीष्मो मर्माणि कृन्तति॥ तथैव तव सैन्यस्य पार्थेन च महात्मना। नवमेघप्रतीकाशा: पातिता बहुधा गजाः॥
en: Just as bleak wintry cold penetrates into the very vitals of the kine, so did then Bhishma cut the army of the sons of the Pandu to the very quick. Then many elephants of your army loO king like newly formed clouds, were felled by the high-souled son of Pritha in that battle.

sa: पुत्रो हुतवहस्यात्र नीलः सेनापतिः स्वयम्। अनिलस्य तु पुत्रोऽत्र हनूमानिति विश्रुतः॥
en: Nīla himself is the son of the bearer of sacrificial oblations;* and Hanumán is famed as the son of the Wind-god. * Fire.

sa: भरतं मूर्च्छितं दृष्ट्वा विवर्णवदनो गुहः। बभूव व्यथितस्तत्र भूमिकम्पे यथा द्रुमः॥
en: Seeing Bharata deprived of his senses with his countenance covered with pallor, Guha became exceedingly agitated, like a tree during an earth quake.

sa: तस्मिंस्तु दशमे प्राप्ते दिवसे भरतर्षभ। भीष्मेणैकेन मत्स्येषु पञ्चालेषु च संयुगे॥
en: One that the tenth day of the battle, O foremost of the Bharatas, from among the Matsyas and the Panchalas, Bhishma, single handed,

sa: रामस्य वचनं श्रुत्वा द्वा:स्थो मूर्ध्नि कृताञ्जलिः। लक्ष्मणस्य गृहं गत्वा प्रविवेशानिवारितः॥
en: Hearing the words of Rāma and placing his folded palms on his head the warder reached house of Lakşmaņa and unobstructed entered therein.

sa: युद्धं कृत्वा महद् घोरं पञ्चाहानि महाबलः। ब्राह्मणो निहतो राजन् ब्रह्मलोकमवाप्तवान्॥
en: O king, having warred savagely for five days, the Brahmana (Drona) endued with great strength, fell and repaired to the region of Brahma.

sa: तेषामपि महाबाहो साहाय्यं मधुसूदन। क्रियतामिति तत् कृष्णो नास्य चक्रे वचस्तदा॥
en: "O mighty-armed one, O slayer of Madhu, let us help the Kurus.” Krishna, however, did not pay heed to those words of his.

sa: समागम्य महाराज मन्त्रं चक्रुर्विवक्षितम्। कथं पाण्डुसुताः संख्ये जेतव्याः सगणा इति॥
en: These assembled together, O monarch, began to consult as to 'how could the sons of Pandu with their partisans be conquered in battle.'

sa: कैकेयी च सुमित्रा च कौसल्या च यशस्विनी। रामानयनसंतुष्टा ययुर्यानेन भास्वता॥
en: Kaikeyi and Sumitrā and the highly famous Kausalyā rejoicing at the prospect of the bringing of Rāma, went in an effulgent car. cars

sa: ते प्रयाता यथोद्दिष्टा दूतास्त्वरितवाहनाः। तत्र कंचित् प्रयातं तु दूतं दुःशासनोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Ascending swift cars, they went to the directions assigned to them. Then to one messenger at the point of starting thus spoke Dushashana.

sa: तावद्भिरेव चिच्छेद शरैः काञ्चनभूषितैः। ततः पश्यान्महातेजा नाराचान् सूर्यसंनिभान्॥ जग्राह परमकुद्धश्चतुर्दश शिलाशितान्। गृहीत्वा धनुरायम्य लक्ष्यानुद्दिश्य राक्षसान्॥ मुमोच राघवो बाणान् वज्रानिव शतक्रतुः।
en: Seeing this, that exceedingly cnergetic one, waxing highly enraged, look out fourteen darts with many golden arrows, whetted on stone, resembling the sun. And even as Satakratu hurls the thunder bolt, Rāghava drawing his bow and taking his aim at the Rākşasas, let go those shafts.

sa: तौ त्वया प्राकृतेनेव गत्वा ज्ञेयौ प्लवङ्गम। इङ्गितानां प्रकारैश्च रूपव्याभाषणेन च॥
en: O monkey, do you proceed under a false guise and come by their intentions, examining them aright by their countenances, gestures and words.

sa: जनपदः संनिकर्षगतः सदा। अक्षुद्रः सत्पथालम्बी स राजा राज्यभाग्भवेत्॥ यस्य नार्तो
en: That king, whose subjects are always happy and magnanimous, and who always went to path of the righteous, enjoys the happiness of sovereignty.

sa: कुलं वपदिशन् वीरः समरे कोऽभिधास्यति। मृत्युकाले तु सम्प्राप्ते स्वयमप्रस्तवे स्तवम्॥
en: What hero, when the hour of his death has approached, publishes in the field his own lofty lineage and sings his own hymn.

sa: इहाद्य रजनीमेकां सुखं स्वप्स्यामहे वयम्। श्वः प्रभाते नरश्रेष्ठ जनकं द्रष्टुमर्हसि॥
en: And here will we happily spend a night; an on the morning of the morrow you will, O foremost of men, behold Janaka.'

sa: युष्मान् पापात्मकान् हन्तुं विप्रकारान् महाहवे। ऋषीणां तु नियोगेन सम्प्राप्तः सशरासनः॥
en: It is do destroy you, wicked, and troublesome that I equipped with the bow have come here at the desire of the saints.

sa: अपराजितस्य सुनसं तव पुत्रस्य संयुगे। पराजितस्य भीमेन निपपात शिरो महीम्॥
en: Your son Aparajita, graced with a well formed nose. When he was thus conquered by Bhima, his head fell down on the ground.

sa: ये त्वया दण्डकारण्ये भक्षिता धर्मचारिणः। तानद्य निहतः संख्ये ससैन्योऽनुगमिष्यसि ॥
en: Slain in battle, you shall in company with your army, follow those people practising piety, whom you have devoured in the Dandaka forest.

sa: तांस्तु हत्वा ततः काकान् कौशिको मुदितोऽभवत्।।४३ प्रतिकृत्य यथाकामं शत्रूणां शत्रुसूदनः।
en: Having killed those crows, the owl became overjoyed like a slayer of foes after having dealt with his foes according to his pleasure.

sa: तत् तस्य समरे कर्म दृष्ट्वान्यैरकृतं पुरा॥ चारणां सहगन्धर्वाः पूजयाञ्चक्रिरे भृशम्।
en: Beholding that feat achieved in battle by him-fcat that nobody before ever performed, the Charanas and the Gandharvas began to applaud him highly.

sa: अहं सर्वान् महाराज निहनिष्यामि सोमकान्। पञ्चालान् केकयैः सार्धं करूषांश्चेति भारत॥
en: Do you slay the heroic sons of Pandu like the great Indra slaying the Danavas. 'O monarch, I shall slaughter all the Somakas,

sa: तत् तस्य समरे कर्म दृष्ट्वान्यैरकृतं पुरा॥ चारणां सहगन्धर्वाः पूजयाञ्चक्रिरे भृशम्।
en: Beholding that feat achieved in battle by him-fcat that nobody before ever performed, the Charanas and the Gandharvas began to applaud him highly.

sa: तेषामपि तु बाणास्ते तन्मातलिरपूजयत्। अवाकिरन् मां बलवत् तानहं व्यधमं शरैः॥
en: And the skillfulness with which displaying prowess, I cut off, with my shafts, their arrows which completely surrounded me, drew admiration from Matali.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच प्राचेतसस्य दक्षस्य कथं वैवस्वतेऽन्तरे। विनाशमगमद् ब्रह्मन् हयमेधः प्रजापतेः॥
en: Janamejaya said How, O Brahmana, was the Horse-sacrifice of the Prajapati Daksha, the son of Prachetas, destroyed during the time of Vaivasvata Manu?

sa: वसूनेव महातेजा भीष्मः प्राप महाद्युतिः॥ अष्टावेव हि दृश्यन्ते वसवो भरतर्षभ।
en: Bhishma of great energy and great effulgence acquired the dignity of the Vasus. Eight Vasus, O chief of Bharata's race, are now seen.

sa: स विहायोत्तरीयाणि महार्हाणि महायशाः। विसृज्य मनसा राज्यं जनन्यै मां समादिशत्॥
en: Leaving aside his costly attire, the highly glorious (Rāma) renounced with all his heart the kingdom and gave me over to his mother.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा ब्राह्मणाय राजा गोसहस्रं ददौ। प्राप्तवांश्च गवां सहस्रं ब्राह्मण इति॥
en: Markandeya said : Having said this. the king gave one thousand kine to the Brahmanas and the Brahmana also obtained one thousand kine.

sa: अथ मामब्रवीद् रामः क्रोधपर्याकुलेक्षणः। न करिष्यसि चेदेतद् वाक्यं मे नरपुङ्गव॥
en: Then did Rama say to me with eyes expanded with wrath:-“If you do not act up to my words, O best among men,

sa: मयि सर्वाणि भूतानि सर्वभूतेषु चाप्यहम्। स्थित इत्यभिजानीहि मा तेऽभूदत्र संशयः॥
en: In me are all creatures, and in all creatures do I exist know this. Let no doubt arise in your mind about this.

sa: केन प्रभावेण भवा नित्यं क्रीडति राजवत्। विज्ञातव्यं न जानीते भयस्थानमुपस्थितम्॥
en: It must be known by what influence Bhavasvara sport here king-like. He does not know that an occasion of fear has presented itself?'

sa: सदसच्चैव यत् प्राहुरव्यक्तं व्यक्तमेव च। अक्षरं च क्षरं चैव सर्वमेतन्मदात्मकम्॥
en: Whatever has been called existent and nonexistent, whatever is manifest, and notmanifest, whatever is destructible and indestructible, all have me for their soul.

sa: तपसा सत्यवाक्येन अनन्यत्वाच्च भर्तरि। असौ विनिर्दहेदग्नि न तामग्निः प्रधक्ष्यति ॥
en: By virtue of her asceticism, veracity, and devotion to her lord she it is that can consume Fire, but Fire cannot burn her.

sa: ततो मुहूर्तं स ध्यात्वा धार्तराष्ट्रो महामनाः। कृपं शारद्वतं वाक्यमित्युवाच परंतपः॥
en: Having thought for a little while, the great son of Dhritarashtra, that scorcher of foes, then said these words to Sharadvat's son Kripa-

sa: ततो मुनिवरस्तूर्ण जगाम सहराघवः। विशाला नगरी रम्यां दिव्यां स्वर्गोपमां तदा॥
en: And thereupon speedily that that foremost of ascetics in company with Rāghava, went towards Viśālā, beautiful and elegant like to the celestial regions.

sa: मारुते संनिवृत्ते च बलौ च प्रतिपादिते॥ चिन्ताव्याकुलितात्मानो जाता: स्मोऽङ्गिरसां वर।
en: After the breeze has ceased and the sacrifice had been over, our hearts became stricken with anxiety, O foremost one of Angiras's race.

sa: यदि त्वं प्रस्थितो दुर्गं वनमद्यैव राघव। अग्रतस्ते गमिष्यामि मृद्गन्ती कुशकण्टकान्॥
en: If do you repair today to the forest impregnable, I shall go before you, oh Rāghava, treading upon the thorns and prickly grass.

sa: अधर्मः परमो राजन्द्वापरे शूद्रजन्मनः। स वै विषयपर्यन्ते तव राजन्महातपाः॥ अद्य तप्यति दुर्बुद्धिस्तेन बालवधो ह्ययम्। यो ह्यधर्ममकार्य वा विषये पार्थिवस्य तु॥
en: O king, even in Davāpara, devout penances for Śūdras were considered as impiety, what to speak of the Tretāage. O king, one Śūdras, under the influence of vicious understanding, has begun devout penances within your kingdom. And for that reason this boy has met with death.

sa: प्रसन्नस्ते पिता राम यत्त्वं राज्यमवाप्स्यसि। उपवासं भवानद्य करोतु सह सीतया॥
en: O Rāma your father has been well pleased with you; since you achieve the kingdom (through him). Do you to-day fast with Sītā.

sa: अहं पञ्चसु भूतेषु मनःषष्ठेषु राघव। विचिन्त्य सीता शुद्धति जग्राह वननिझरे॥
en: O descendant of Raghu, finding Sitä pure in mind and five elements of body I took her near the spring in the forest.

sa: दितेः पुत्रा न तां राम जगृहुर्वरुणात्मजाम्। अदितेस्तु सुता वीर जगृहुस्तामनिन्दिताम्॥
en: And Diti's sons, O Rāma, did not accept the daughter of Varuna and Aditi's sons, O hero, accepted that one of blameless limbs.

sa: इत्येतद् वचनं श्रुत्वा भारद्वाजस्य सारथिः। प्रत्युवाच ततो द्रोणं सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरम्॥
en: Replied unto Drona that foremost of all wielders of weapons saying-"O long-lived one, behold the army of the Kauravas routed in all directions.

sa: तत्र योधा महाराज विचरन्तो ह्यभीतवत्। दृश्यन्ते रुधिराक्ताङ्गाः पुष्पिता इव किंशुकाः॥
en: Then, on the field of battle, O monarch, warriors moved about fearlessly, their limbs bathed in blood and, therefore, looking like flowering Kinshukas.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्युक्त्वा न्यपतद् भूमौ गान्धारी शोकमूर्छिता। दुःखोपहतविज्ञाना धैर्यमुत्सृज्य भारत॥
en: Vaishampayana said “Having said so, Gandhari, beside herself with grief, dropped down on the Earth. Losing her fortitude, she became overwhelmed with grief.

sa: गतेष्वथ नृपो भूयः पौरेषु सह मन्त्रिभिः। मन्त्रयित्वा ततश्चके निश्चयज्ञः स निश्चयम्॥ श्व एव पुष्यो भविता श्वोऽभिषेच्यस्तु मे सुतः। रामो राजीवपत्राक्षो युवराज इति प्रभुः॥
en: When the citizens had gone away, the king versed in the time and place of ceremonies, after deliberating with his counsellors fixed the time (of the installation.) And his conclusion was even this: "To-morrow the Pusya will be in; and to-morrow should my son, Rāma of eyes like lotus-leaves be installed as heir-apparent."

sa: यथा मृत्पिण्डतः कर्ता कुरुते यद् यदिच्छति। एवमात्मकृतं कर्म मानवः प्रतिपद्यते॥
en: As men make from a lump of clay whatever they wish to make, so do men come by various results out of Karma.

sa: स व्यासवाक्यमुदितो बनाद् द्वैतवनात् ततः। ययौ सरस्वतीकूले काम्यकं नाम काननम्॥
en: Being glad at the words of Vyasa, he, leaving the Dvaiytavana, went to the forest of Kamyaka on the banks of the Sarasvati.

sa: पूर्वमेव हि ते सूक्ष्मैरुपायैर्यतितास्त्वया। निग्रहीतुं तदा वीर न चैव शकितास्त्वया।॥
en: O hero, you have formerly tried to accomplish your wishes by various subtlc means, but you have not been successful in killing them.

sa: मृगधूमं ततो गच्छेत् त्रिषु लोकेषु विश्रुतम्। तत्राभिषेकं कुर्वीत गङ्गायां नृपसत्तम॥
en: One should then go to Mrigadhuma, celebrated all over the there worlds. O best of kings, one should bathe there in the Ganges.

sa: न नित्यं परिभूयारीन् सुखं स्वपिति वासव। जागर्येव हि दुष्टात्मा संकरेऽग्निरिवोत्थितः॥
en: Having defeated one's enemies, one should not sleep at ease. A wicked enemy rises up against like a fire carelessly extinguished reappearing itself.

sa: संस्मृत्य मन्त्रितं पूर्वं निग्रहे भीमकर्मणः। निश्चयं परमं कृत्वा निग्रहीतुं प्रचक्रमुः॥
en: Bearing in mind their pre-concerted plan of afflicting Bhima of fierce deeds, began with an earnest determination, to strike him (from all sides).

sa: सर्वे विप्राश्च देवाश्च तथा शमविदो जनाः। ब्रह्मण्यं परमं देवमनन्तं परमच्युतम्॥
en: All learned Brahmanas and all the gods and all pious men consider it as originating from Brahma. Supreme, Divine, Infinite, Immutable, and Undeteriorating.

sa: जरामृत्यू हि भूतानां खादितारौ वृकाविव। बलिनां दुर्बलानां च हस्वानां महतामपि॥
en: Like wolves, descrepitude and death are devourers of all creatures. Indeed, they devour the strong and the weak, the short and the tall.

sa: यथा सूक्ष्माणि कर्माणि फलन्तीह यथातथम्। बुद्धियुक्तानि तानीह कृतानि मनसा सह॥
en: Whatever acts are done by the mind with full deliberation, yield, according to their grossness or subtility, fruits which are gross or subtile.

sa: पश्य दैवस्य संयोगं बान्धवानां च निश्चयम्॥ कृपणानां तु रुदतां कृतमश्रुप्रमार्जनम्।
en: Mark the combination of circumstances and the determination of those kinsmen. While crying with heavy hearts, their tears were wiped and dried up.

sa: शकुनानामिवाकाशे मत्स्यानामिव चोदके। पदं यथा न दृश्येत तथा पुण्यकृतां गतिः॥
en: The path of the righteous cannot be discerned even as that of birds in the sky or that of fishes in the water.

sa: भीष्म उवाच एवमुक्तस्तु दैत्येन्द्रो बलिरिन्द्रेण भारत। जगाम दक्षिणामाशामुदीची तु पुरंदरः॥
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed by Indra, O Bharata, Vali the king of the Daityas proceeded towards the south. Purandara proceeded towards the north.

sa: एवमेतत् पुरावृत्तं लुब्धकस्य महात्मनः। कपोतस्य च धर्मिष्ठा गतिः पुण्येन कर्मणा॥
en: This is the ancient history of the great fowler and the pigeon. Thus did they acquire highly meritorious end by their righteous acts.

sa: ततः कृतप्रतिज्ञो वै स पक्षी प्रहसनिव) तमग्निं त्रि:परिक्रम्य प्रविवेश महामतिः॥
en: Having thus made up his mind, the great bird, with a smiling face, thrice went round that fire and then entered its flames.

sa: अभयं यस्य भूतेभ्यः सर्वेषामभयं यतः। नमस्यः सर्वभूतानां दान्तो भवति बुद्धिमान्॥
en: Endued with intelligence, and deserving of universal reverence, the self-controlled man never fears any creature and is feared by no creature in return.

sa: संकर्षणाच्च प्रद्युम्नो मनोभूतः स उच्यते। प्रद्युम्नाद् योऽनिरुद्धस्तु सोऽहंकारः स ईश्वरः॥
en: From Sankarshana originates Praddyumna who is called “Mind-begotten." From Praddymuna is He who is Aniruddha. He is Consciousness, He is Ishvara (Supreme Lord).

sa: अन्तकाले [पासन्ते तपसा दग्धकिल्बिषाः। सर्व एते महात्मानो गच्छन्ति परमां गतिम्॥
en: Others who have consumed their sins by penances, attain to Brahman in the end. All these great persons attain to the highest end.

sa: मूर्धा यस्य त्वनन्तं च स्थानं दानवसत्तम। तस्याहं ते प्रवक्ष्यामि विष्णोर्माहात्म्यमुत्तमम्॥
en: I shall speak to you of the pre-eminent greatness of that Vishnu whose head, O best of the Danavas, is that Infinite place.

sa: चन्दनागुरुमुख्यानि त्वक्पत्राणां वनानि च। तस्मिन् पथि महाराज सेवमानो द्रुतं ययौ॥
en: Seeing the sandal and aloe and birch trees that stood along the road, and enjoying their refreshing shade, the Brahmana went on quickly.

sa: तेषां रुदितशब्देन गृध्रोऽभ्येत्य वचोऽब्रवीत्। एकात्मजमिमं लोके त्यक्त्वा गच्छत मा चिरम्॥
en: Hearing their cries, a vulture came there and said-Go away, and do not delay, you who have to cast off but one child!

sa: दरिद्रश्चासवर्णश्च ममायमिति पार्थिवः। न दित्सति सुतां तस्मै तां विप्राय सुदर्शनाम्॥
en: The king was reluctant to give his daughter in marriage to the Brahmana who was poor and not of equal rank with himself.

sa: तेभ्यः सृजति भूतानि काल आत्मप्रचोदितः। एतेभ्यो यः परं ब्रूयादसद् ब्रूयादसंशयम्॥
en: Time, moved by the Understanding, created other objects from them. He who says that there is anything else save these, says the untruth.

sa: तावुभौ सुभृशं तप्तौ राजानमिदमूचतुः। परीक्ष्य त्वं यथा स्याबो नावामिह विगर्हितौ॥
en: Both of them, greatly exercises in dispute, then addressed the king, saying,-See, O king, that none of us may be visited by sin!

sa: यथाग्निः पवनोद्भूतः सुसूक्ष्मोऽपि महान् भवेत्। तथा कर्मसमायुक्तं दैवं साधु विवर्धते॥
en: Even as small fire, when fanned by the wind, becomes highly powerful, so does Destiny, when helped by individual Exertion, becomes greatly potent.

sa: संध्यांशे समनुप्राप्ते त्रेताया द्वापरस्य च। अहं दाशरथी रामो भविष्यामि जगत्पतिः॥
en: Towards the end of Treta and the beginning of Dvapara, I shall take birth as Rama the son of Dasharatha in Ikshvaku's race.

sa: मधु तैलं पयः सर्पिर्मांसानि लवणं गुडः। धान्यानि फलमूलानि मृविकाराः सहाम्भसा॥
en: Honey, oil, milk, butter, meat, salt, treacle and grain of all kinds and fruit and roots are all modifications of earth and water.

sa: पृथिव्यां यानि भूतानि जङ्गमानि ध्रुवाणि च। तान्येवाने प्रलीयन्ते भूमित्वमुपयान्ति च॥
en: All things mobile and immobile that are on the Earth first disappear and merge into the substance of which this planet is formed.

sa: अकृत्वा मानुषं कर्म यो दैवमनुवर्तते। वृथा श्राम्यति सम्प्राप्य पतिं क्लीबमिवाङ्गना॥
en: He who, without following the human modes of action follows Destiny only, acts in vain, like the woman who has an impotent husband.

sa: मशकोदुम्बरौ वापि सम्प्रयुक्तौ यथा सदा। अन्योन्यमेतौ स्यातां च सम्प्रयोगस्तथा तयोः॥
en: A gnat and a fig may be seen to be united with each other. Though united, each, however, is separate from the other.

sa: नाम्नां सहस्रं देवस्य तण्डिना ब्रह्मयोनिना। निवेदितं ब्रह्मलोके ब्रह्मणो यत् पुराभवत्॥
en: In days of yore, the Rishi Tandin, originated from Brahman, recited in Brahman's region and before Brahman himself the thousand names of Mahadeva.

sa: ततः स मुनिरुत्थाय काश्यपस्तमुवाच ह। अहो बतासि कुशलो बुद्धिमांश्चेति विस्मित:॥
en: Thus addressed, the ascetic Kashyapa, rising up, said-0, you are surely endued with great knowledge, and intelligence. I really wonder at all this.

sa: पूर्वोपायोपपन्नेन मार्गेण वरवर्णिनि। न मे सुराः प्रयच्छन्ति भागं यज्ञस्य धर्मतः॥
en: According to that arrangement, O fair one, the gods do not give me, following the old custom, any share of the sacrificial offerings!

sa: प्रीणितश्चापि भवति महतोऽर्थानवाप्य हि। करोति पुप्यं तत्रापि जीवन्निव च पश्यति॥
en: In his dreams he acquires great riches and feels highly satisfied: performs meritorious acts, and sees as he does when he is awake.

sa: अश्वत्थामा च रामश्च मुनिपुत्रौ धनुर्धरौ। न गच्छतः स्वर्गलोकं सुकृतेनेह कर्मणा॥
en: Ashvatthaman and Rama, though both warriors and Sons of Ascetics, failed to acquired heaven by virtue of their own actions in this world.

sa: पुरस्ताद् दारुणो भूत्वा सुचित्रतरमेव तत्। अनुगृह्णाति भूतानि स्वेन वृत्तेन पार्थिवः॥
en: First becoming exceedingly stern, a king then shows mercy and does good to all creatures by his acts. This is certainly very wonderful.

sa: अहोरात्रं च कालं च यथर्तु मधुसूदनः। पूर्वाह्न चापराह्नं च सर्वमेवानुकल्पयत्॥
en: The destroyer of Madhu also created the Day and the Night, and the Seasons in their order, and the Morning and the Evening.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच पितामह महाप्राज्ञ सर्वशास्त्रविशारद। दैवे पुरुषकारे च किंस्विच्छ्रेष्ठतरं भवेत्॥
en: Yudhishthira said Of Exertion and Destiny, tell me O learned sire who are versed in all the scriptures, which is the more potent?

sa: पश्यन्तु योगवीर्यं मे सर्वे देवाः सहर्षािभिः॥६ अथानुज्ञाप्य तमृर्षि नारदं लोकविश्रुतम्।
en: Let all the gods with the Rishis, witness my Yoga power to-day.-Having said these words, Shuka, informed the illustrious Narada of his intention.

sa: सर्वात्मानं महात्मानं विधूममिव पावकम्। तं पश्यन्ति महात्मानो ब्राह्मणा ये मनीषिणः॥
en: Those great Brahmanas who are endud with wisdom succeed in seeing that Supreme and Universal Soul which resembles a blazing fire in effulgence.

sa: मध्ये वै पापयोनीनां शार्गाली यामहं गतः। पापीयस्यो बहुतरा इतोऽन्याः पापयोनयः॥
en: This birth, to which I now belong, is rather tolerable. Miserable as it is, there are many more orders below it which miserable.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच नमो भवगते तस्मै व्यासायामिततेजसे॥ यस्य प्रसादाद् वक्ष्यामि नारायणकथामिमाम्।
en: Vaishampayana said Salutations to the holy Vyasa of incomparable energy. Through his favour; I shall recite this narrative having Narayana for its theme.

sa: राज्ञां विजयमानानां सेनाग्रेषु ध्वजेषु च। निवासे धर्मशीलानां विषयेषु पुरेषु। च॥
en: I live at the van and on the standards of victorious and virtuous kings, as well as in their homes, cities, and kingdoms.

sa: तेन संनादशब्देन लोकानां क्षोभ आगमत्। संत्रस्ताश्च भृशं लोके देवाः शक्रपुरोगमा:॥
en: The very gods headed by Indra became terror-stricken. The whole universe became calm in consequence of that sound. It was a dreadful time.

sa: प्रोक्तानि मुनिभिः श्रुत्वा विस्मयामास पाण्डवः। ततः कृष्णोऽब्रवीद् वाक्यं पुनर्मतिमतां वरः॥
en: Then Krishna that foremost of all intelligent persons, then spoke once more to Yudhishthira, that sea of virtue, like Vishnu speaking to Puruhuta.

sa: स तैजसेन भावेन यदि तत्र रमत्युत। गुणास्तेषां समाधत्ते रागेण प्रतिमोहितः॥
en: If he plays there in his new form, then stupefied by such attachment, he is affected by the attributes of those particular regions.

sa: इदं तु लब्ध्वा संस्थानमात्मानं बहु मन्यसे। सर्वभूतभवं देवं ब्रह्माणमिव शाश्वतम्॥
en: Having secured your present position, you think too much of yourself, even as the Creator of all beings, the divine and eternal Brahman.

sa: परिग्रहं परित्यज्य भव तात जितेन्द्रियः। अशोकं स्थानमातिष्ठ इह चामुत्र चाभयम्॥
en: Renouncing all attachments, O child, do you master all your senses, and thereby acquire happiness both in this world and in the next.

sa: अम्बरीषो गवां दत्त्वा ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रतापवान्। अर्बुदानि दशैकं च सराष्ट्रोऽभ्यपतद् दिवम्॥
en: Having given to the Brahmanas eleven Arvudas of kine, Amvarisha of great prowess, proceeded to heaven with all the denizens of his kingdom.

sa: यस्मादुद्विजते लोकः सर्पाद् वेश्मगतादिव। न स धर्ममवाप्नोति इहलोके परत्र च॥
en: He whom every body fears like a snake lying in ones bed-room, never acquires any merit in this world or in the next.

sa: बलेन संविभागैश्च जय स्वर्ग जनेश्वर। यस्यैव बलमोजश्च स धर्मस्य प्रभुर्नरः॥
en: By showing your power and liberality do you conquer heaven, O king. that man who is endued with might and energy acquired righteousness.

sa: स रुदन्नगमत् पुत्रो राक्षसेन्द्रस्य धीमतः॥ त्वरमाणः परं शक्त्या गौतमग्रहणाय वै।
en: Weeping with sorrow the son of the intelligent king of the Rakshasas, ran quickly to the best of his power, for seizing Gautama.

sa: ततः सा त्वरितं गत्वा तत् सर्वं प्रत्यवेदयत्। मातुश्चिकीर्षितं राजन् ऋचीकस्तामथाब्रवीत्॥
en: Then, O king, returning speedily to her husband Richika, the princess described to him all that had been wished for by her mother.

sa: महान्तो यत्र विविधा मणिकाञ्चपर्वताः। विमानानि च रम्याणि रत्नानि विविधानि च॥
en: Around it there were many hills and mounts of jewels and gems. Many beautiful cars and heaps of jewels also were seen there.

sa: अन्यान्यपि सुरम्याणि पश्यतः सुबहून्यथ। भृशं तस्य मनो रेमे महर्षे वितात्मनः॥
en: And he saw various other highly beautiful objects. Seeing these things, the mind of that Rishi of purified soul became filled with joy.

sa: एवमुक्तः प्रत्युवाच शृगालो वानरं तदा। ब्राह्मणस्य प्रतिश्रुत्य न मया तदुपाहतम्॥
en: Thus addressed the jackal replied to the ape, saving Having promised to give to a Brahmana I did not make him the gift.

sa: रुरोद राजा तं दृष्ट्वा सामात्यः सपुरोहितः। आर्तनादश्च सुमहानभूत् तस्य निवेशने॥
en: Seeing the remains of his friend, the king, with his counsellors and priest, began to weep aloud. Loud-lamentations were heard in his house.

sa: अहिंसा सत्यवचनं सर्वभूतेषु चार्जयम्। क्षमा चैवाप्रमादश्च यस्यैते स सुखी भवेत्॥
en: He enjoys happiness who practises abstention from injuring (others), truthfulness of speech, honesty towards all creatures, and forgiveness, and who is never careless.

sa: अश्वमेधसहस्रस्य वाजपेयशतस्य च। योगस्य कलया तात न तुल्यं विद्यते फलम्॥
en: The merit of a thousand Horse-sacrifices or a hundred Vajapeyas is not equal to even a sixteenth part of the merit of Yoga.

sa: कदाचित् पुनरभ्येत्य पुनर्गच्छन्ति संततम्। त्यक्ता मातापितृभ्यां ते न चाकम्पत जाजलिः॥
en: Sometime after he saw that, left by their parents, they went out alone and came back again alone, Jajali did not still move.

sa: तस्माद् धर्मे प्रवर्तेथाः सर्वावस्थं युधिष्ठिर। धर्मे स्थितानां कौन्तेय सिद्धिर्भवति शाश्वती॥
en: You should, therefore, O Yudhishthira, follow virtue under all circumstances. Eternal is the success, O son of Kunti, of you who follow righteousness.

sa: माहात्म्यमात्मयोगं च विज्ञानं च शुकस्य ह। यथावदानुपूर्येण तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह॥
en: Tell me, grandfather, in their due order, of the greatness, and the knowledge of Shuka and of his union with the (Supreme) Soul!

sa: प्रजाभिः स परित्यक्तश्चकार कुशलं महत्। अतिवेलं तपस्तेपे दह्यमानः स मन्युना॥
en: Deserted by his subjects too, he adopted this course for acquiring great merit. Reduced by repentance, the king practised the most rigid austerities.

sa: सहस्रपादं प्रासादं स्वप्नान्ते स्म युधिष्ठिरः। अधिरोहन् मया दृष्टं सह भ्रातृभिरच्युत॥
en: In a dream dreamt by me, O Achyuta, I saw Yudhishthira in company with his brothers ascending a palace having a thousand pillars.

sa: अक्षयूतं महाप्राज्ञ सतां मतिविनाशनम्। असतां तत्र जायन्ते भेदाश्च व्यसनानि च॥
en: O greatly wise man, dice destroys the intelligence of the honest and in the dishonest it gives rise to disputes and other troubles.

sa: ततो विसर्जयामास भीष्मादीन् कुरुपुङ्गवान्। आरोप्याथ रथे कर्णं प्रायात् सात्यकिना सह॥
en: Then he sent away those best among the Kuru race Bhishma and others and getting up on the chariot he departed with Satyaki.

sa: शत्रुरेष त्वया वीर देवगन्धर्वभोगिनाम्। यक्षाणां दानवानां च महर्षीणां च पातितः॥३.।।
en: O hero, this enemy of the gods, the Gandharvas, the Uragas, the Yakshas, the Danavas and the Maharshis has been destroyed by yol.

sa: स सूतो भार्यया सार्धं विस्मयोत्फुल्ललोचनः। अङ्कमारोप्य तं बालं भार्यां वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: That Suta together with his wife with eyes expanded in wonder, took the infant on his lap and spoke these words to her.

sa: युवराजोऽस्तु ते राजा धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। गृहीत्वा व्यजनं श्वेतं धर्मात्मा संशितव्रतः॥
en: Let also king Yudhishthira, the son of Dharma be your hair-apparent; having taken the white chamara let that virtuous-souled one, of restrained senses,

sa: किं नु शक्यं मया कर्तुं यत् त्वमद्यापि मानुषम्॥ आहारभूतमस्माकं राममेवानुरुध्यसे॥
en: What am I able to do since you even to this day cherish Rama, who is but a man (and therefore) our food"

sa: तस्य पुत्रा बभूवुर्हि पञ्च राजर्षिसत्तमाः। तेषां यदुर्महातेजा ज्येष्ठः समभवत् प्रभुः॥
en: He had five sons, the best among royal sages and of them Yadu of great energy was the firs, and was the lord.

sa: स मालया तदा वीरः शुशुभे कण्ठसक्तया। श्रीमानिव महाशैलो मलयो मेघमालया॥
en: Thereupon that hero adorned with that garland on his neck shone like the beautiful and mighty Malaya mountain encircled with the clouds. in

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच अपयाते तु राधेये दुर्योधनपुरोगमाः। अनीकेन यथास्वेन शनैरार्छन्त पाण्डवम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said After the son of Radha had fled away fi the battle-field all other heroes, headed Duryodhana attacked Arjuna with respective detachments.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच सर्वाजानपदाञ्जित्वा वित्तमादाय केवलम्। मध्ये धनस्य तिष्ठामि तेनाहुर्मी धनंजयम्॥
en: Arjuna said Having conquered all countries, and collected their wealth I lived in the midst of riches and so they call me Dhananjaya.

sa: विदितं ते महाबाहो धर्मज्ञ मधुसूदन। यथा निकृतिमास्थाय भ्रंशिताः पाण्डवाः सुखात्॥
en: O you of long arms, this is known to you. slayer of Madhu, how the Pandavas were deprived of all happiness through deceit.

sa: सर्वे समधिरूढाः स्म संग्रामानः समुद्धर। जानामि त्वां महाबाहो क्षत्रधर्मे व्यवस्थितम्॥
en: Rescue us from this fight; I am aware that you, O you with long arms, are established on the virtue of a Kshatriya.

sa: कारयामास सर्वाणि मङ्गलार्थानि वै विभुः। तं ब्राह्मणाश्च वृद्धाश्च पौरजानपदैः सह॥
en: That lord had all auspicious arrangements made, but the Brahmanas and the old men among the citizens with the subjects of the province,

sa: अचिन्तयन्नमेयात्मा सर्वं तद् राजमण्डलम्। निश्चकाम ततः शौरिः सधूम इव पावकः॥
en: Shouri, of immeasurable soul, however without thinking of that entire assembly of kings (that followed him), went out like fire accompanied with smoke.

sa: ग्रसन्तमिव लोकांस्त्रीन् सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ यथा। ददृशुस्ते ततो वृत्रं शक्रेण सह देवताः॥
en: Those gods, with Indra, then saw Vritra who seemed as if swallowing the three worlds and looking as the sun or the moon.

sa: सर्वैरपि च वक्तव्यं न प्राज्ञायन्त पाण्डवाः। गता ह्यस्मानपाहाय सर्वे द्वैतवनादिति॥
en: All of them also must say this "we do not know the Pandavas, they have all departed from Dvaitavana leaving us alone here."

sa: यथा स्वं वान्तमश्नाति श्वा वै नित्यमभूतये। एवं ते वान्तमश्नन्ति स्ववीर्यस्योपसेवनात्॥
en: As dogs eat up their own vomit to their constant injury, so they who proclaim their own worth eat up their own vomit.

sa: मम प्रसादानिर्जित्य हत्वा कौरवाहिनीम्॥ राज्यं निष्कण्टकं कृत्वा भोक्ष्यसे मेदिनीं पुनः।
en: Having defeated and slaughtered the Kaurava forces through my benediction and rendered the kingdom destitute of thorns you shall enjoy the earth again.

sa: अन्ने तेऽधर्मनिरता बद्धाः कालेन पीडिताः। दैतेया निवसन्ति स्म वासवेन हतश्रियः॥
en: Here are iroprisoned these wicked and unrighteous sons of Diti afflicted with misfortune. They live here being dispossessed of their prosperity by Vasava.

sa: गते द्वारवती कृष्णे बलदेवे च माधवे। सह वृष्ण्यन्धकैः सर्वैर्भोजैश्च शतशस्तदा।॥
en: sons The of Madhu, Krishna and Balarama, in company with the Vrishni race and Andhaka and Bhoja by hundreds, having gone to Dvaravati.

sa: सोऽहमेकमपत्यं वै जनयिष्यामि गालव। अस्यामेतं भवान् काम सम्पादयतु मे वरम्॥
en: Such being the case, I shall beget but one child on this damsel, O Galava; kindly act up to this request of mine."

sa: संजयाचक्ष्व मे शूरं भीमसेनममर्षणम्। अतिलाभं तु मन्येऽहं यत् तेन रिपुघातिना॥
en: O Sanjaya, that hero, the wrathful Bhimasena; tell me that; it is a great gain I consider, that by that slayer of enemies.

sa: विशेषतश्च वासार्थं सभां ग्रामे वृकस्थले। विदधे कौरवो राजा बहुरत्नां मनोरमाम्॥
en: Especially for his residence in the town of Vrikasthala the Kuru king erected an enchanting palace adorned with many gems and precious stones.

sa: एतेन व्यवसायेन तत् तोयं व्यवगाढवान्। गाहमानश्च तत् तोयमन्तरिक्षात् स शुश्रुवे॥
en: Thinking it to be certain, he plunged into that water. And as he got into it he heard these words from the firmament.

sa: यं यक्षः पुरुषं चक्रे भीष्मस्य निधनेच्छया। महेष्वासेन रौद्रेण पाण्डवा अभ्ययुञ्जत॥
en: She who was turned into a male through a desire for the death of Bhishma, with that terrific bowman will the Pandavas fight.

sa: ये च संकीर्तयिष्यन्ति लोके विगतकल्मषाः॥ तेषां तुष्टा प्रदास्यामि राज्यमायुर्वपुः सुतम्।
en: I propitiated, will confer, kingdom longevity, goodly form and offspring on those stainless persons who will chant my attributes aloud to the world,

sa: तक्षकेण च नागेन तथैवैरावतेन च। अत्र निर्याणकालेऽपि तमः सम्प्राप्यते महत्॥
en: And by the Naga, Takshaka and also by Airavala; and here at the time of their journey men meet with a great gloom.

sa: प्रत्यक्षदर्शी लोकानां सर्वदर्शी भवेन्नरः। सत्ये वै ब्राह्मणस्तिष्ठंस्तद् विद्वान् सर्वविद् भवेत्।।६२
en: A man, who sees all the worlds before his eyes, sees everything and that learned Brahmana who is established on truth knows everything.

sa: पर्वणि त्वं समुद्दिश्य सुरामन्नं च कारय। तत्रैनां प्रेषयिष्यामि सुराहारी तवान्तिकम्॥
en: Taking the advantage of some festival, better have wines and viands prepared. I shall then send her to you to bring some wine.

sa: उपायेन नृशंसेन हृता दुर्दूतदेविना। कथं हि पुरुषो जातः क्षत्रियेषु धनुर्धरः॥
en: When challenged (for battle) turns back even when death stares on him? Seeing ourselves defeated by deceit and while wandering in the woods.

sa: निर्दिश्यमानेषु तु सा वरेषु वरवर्णिनी। वरानुत्क्रम्य सर्वांस्तान् वरं वृतवती वनम्॥
en: The lady, of good complexion, being directed to choose a husband, passed over all these husbands and selected the forest as her husband.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं कृष्णां मोक्षयित्वा विनिर्जित्य जयद्रथम्। आसांचक्रे मुनिगणैर्धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥
