en: Vaishampayana said : Having thus released Krishna and vanquished Jayadratha, the pious king Yudhishthira took his seat by the side of the ascetics.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच वने निवसतां तेषां पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम्। वर्षाग्येकादशातीयुः कृच्छ्रेण भरतर्षभ॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O best of the Bharata race, thus living in the forest, the high-souled Pandavas spent eleven years in great misery.

sa: यत्र हर्षस्त्वया कार्यः सत्कर्तव्याश्च पाण्डवाः। तत्र शोचसि राजेन्द्र विपरीतमिदं तव।॥
en: O king of kings, when you should express your joy and reward the Pandavas, you are grieving. Your this behaviour is very inconsistent.

sa: असकृद् गच्छ गच्छेति विश्वामित्रेण भाषितः। किं ददानीति बहुशो गालवः प्रत्यभाषत॥
en: The attendant, being spoken to by Vishvamitra saying again and again 'go, go,' said by way of reply “What shall I give you."

sa: हतप्रवीरा रिपवो भूयिष्ठं विदुता दिशः। गृहीत्वा द्रौपदी राजन् निवर्ततु भवानितः॥
en: "Many of the enemy's heroes have been slain; others have fled away to various directions; taking Draupadi with you, O king, return home.

sa: ततो मित्रेषु सर्वेषु वासुदेवं च भारत। प्रेषयामास कौन्तेयो विराटश्च महीपतिः॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, then the son of Kunti sent invitations to all his friends and Vasudeva, and so did the king Virata.

sa: उपस्थास्यति सा त्वां वै पूजयानवमन्य च। तस्याश्च शीलवृत्तेन तुष्टिं समुपयास्यसि॥
en: She, without despising you, will wait on you and minister to your comforts. And you also will be pleased with her (graceful) manners.”

sa: अश्वत्थामा कृपश्चैव कृतवर्मा च सात्वतः। रक्तोष्णीषाश्च दृश्यन्ते सर्वे माधव पार्थिवाः॥
en: they Ashvathama, Kripa and Kritavarman of the Satvata race; all other king of the earth were seen with blood coloured dresses, O Madhava.

sa: रामस्यास्त्रेण पृथिवी परिक्षिप्ता ससागरा। यशसा पृथिवीं कृत्स्ना पूरयिष्यति ते पतिः॥
en: The earth with all its oceans will be covered with Rama's weapons, and your husband will fill the whole world with his renown.

sa: सात्यकिः कृतवर्मा च वृष्णीनां चापरे स्थाः। पृष्ठतोऽनुययुः कृष्णं गजैरश्वैः रथैरपि॥
en: Satyaki and Kritavarma, as also other warriors of the Vrishni race followed behind, some on elephants, some on horse and others on chariots.

sa: रुदती रुधिरार्द्राङ्गी व्याघ्रण परिरक्षिता। असकृत् त्वं मया दृष्टा गच्छन्ती दिशमुत्तराम्॥
en: And I have seen you also lamenting, covered all over with blood and protected by a tiger, repeatedly run towards the southern direction.

sa: बिभ्रती विपुलौ बाहू शक्रध्वजसमुच्छ्यौ। पात्री च परूजी घण्टी स्त्रीविशुद्धा च या भुवि॥ पाशं धनुर्महाचक्रं विविधान्यायुधानि च। कुण्डलाभ्यां सुपूर्णाभ्यां कर्णाभ्यां च विभूषिता॥ चन्द्रविस्पर्द्धिना देवि मुखेन त्वं विराजसे। मुकुटने विचित्रेण केशबन्धेन शोभिना॥
en: O goddess, you appear with a countenance that vies with the moon, vith a pair of well shaped ears decorated with excellent rings, having a pair of large arms like Indra's pole; you are the only female in the world endowed with the attributes of piety, purity-you are the one holding a vessel a lotus, a bell, a noose, a bow and a large discus and various other weapons.

sa: एकः क्षमावतां दोषो द्वितीयो नोपपद्यते। यदेनं क्षमया युक्तमशक्तं मन्यते जनः॥
en: There is but one defect in persons of a forgiving disposition; since people consider this man of a foregoing nature to be weak.

sa: यावत् कीर्तिर्मनुष्यस्य पुण्या लोके प्रगीयते। तावत् स पुरुषव्याघ्र स्वर्गलोके महीयते॥
en: As long as a man's deeds are spoken of in this world, so long, O foremost among men, he is glorious in heaven.

sa: सा भूमौ प्रेक्ष्य भर्तारमुपसृत्योपगृह्य च। उत्सङ्गे शिर आरोप्य भूमावुपविवेश ह॥
en: Beholding her husband on the ground she approached and took hold of him. She then sat down placing his head on her lap.

sa: ईषदाकलितं चापि क्रोधाद् दुतपदं स्थितम्। कीचको बलवान् भीमं जानुभ्यामाक्षिपद् भुवि॥
en: Making him waver a little, the powerful Kichaka speedily stuck Bhima on the breast with his knees and felled him on the ground.

sa: यस्य नागसहस्रेण दशसंख्येन वै बलम्। तुल्यं तं भीममुत्सृज्य नकुलं जीवमिच्छसि॥
en: Why do you, leaving out of consideration Bhima, endued with the strength of ten thousand elephants, desire Nakula to be restored to life?

sa: त्यक्तैर्द्रव्यैर्यद् भवति नोपयुक्तैश्च कामतः। न च द्रव्यैस्तद भवति नोपयुक्तैश्च कामतः॥
en: (The third sort is) that which abandons enjoyments without enjoying them and not that which abandons them after enjoying them to heart's content.

sa: बृहस्पतिरुवाच मानुषो नहुषो राजा देवर्षिगणतेजसा। देवराज्यमनुप्राप्तः सर्वान् नो बाधते भृशम्॥
en: Brihaspati said The human being Nahusha, through the influence of the Devarshis, having gained the kingdom of gods, is very much inflecting us.

sa: शत्रूनेके प्रपद्यन्ते प्रजहत्यपरे पुनः। अन्ये तु प्रजिहीर्षन्ति ये पुरस्ताद् विमानिताः॥
en: One party takes the side of the enemy, another abandons the king, a third again rejoices namely those who have been treated insultingly.

sa: दुर्योधनस्य कर्णस्य शकुनेः सौबलस्य च। वासुदेव मतक्षोऽसि मम सभ्रातृकस्य च॥
en: O Vasudeva, you know the minds of Duryodhana, Karma, Shakuni and the son of Subala as also of myself along with my brothers.

sa: तस्य सेनानिवेशोऽभूदध्यर्धमिव योजनम्। तथा हि विपुलां सेनां बिभर्ति स नरर्षभः॥
en: The encampment of his army occupied one half of a yojana. That foremost among men was the lord of such a large army.

sa: सुव्याहृतानि धीराणां फलतः परिचिन्त्य यः। अध्यवस्यति कार्येषु चिरं यशसि तिष्ठति॥
en: He, who engages in acts after thinking of their effects as prophesied by wise men for the good of mankind, ever remains famous.

sa: न तु शेषं शरास्तात कुर्युरस्ताः किरीटिना। अपि चास्यन्निवाभाति निघ्नन्निव धनंजयः॥
en: But the shafts shot by Kritin leaves no remnant, O dear. I see now (in my mind) Dhananjaya shining forth by working havoc.

sa: गतासु तासु सर्वासु त्रिजटा नाम राक्षसी। सान्त्वयामास वैदेहीं धर्मज्ञा प्रियवादिनी॥
en: They all having gone (to Ravana), a pious Rakshasa woman Trijata by name, who spoke sweet words, (thus) consoled the princess of Videha.

sa: हर्षमेष्यसि वैदेहि क्षिप्रं भ; समन्विता। राघवेण सह भ्रात्रा सीते त्वमचिरादिव॥
en: O princess of Videha, O Sita, being reunited with your husband, the descendant of Raghu, followed by Lakshmana, you will soon experience happiness.”

sa: यश्च तान् संगतान् सर्वान् पाण्डवान् वारणावते। दह्यतो मोचयामास तेन वस्तेऽभ्ययुञ्जत॥
en: Aided by him who liberated all the assembled Pandavas when they were burning at the conflagration of Varanavata they will fight against you.

sa: मया सार्धमितो यातमद्य त्वां तात पाण्डवाः। अभिजानन्तु कौन्तेयं पूर्वजातं युधिष्ठिरात्॥
en: Let the sons of Pandu, my dear friend, know you, accompanying me from here to be the son of Kunti born before Yudhishthira,

sa: सर्वे वेदविदः शूराः सर्वे सुचरितव्रताः। ऊषुः पित्रा सह रता गन्धमादनपर्वते॥
en: All those heroes, well-versed in the Vedas and intent on the performance of religious rites, lived with their father in the Gandhamadana mountain.

sa: इन्द्रजित् कृतकर्मा च पित्रे कर्म तदाऽऽत्मनः। निवेद्य पुनरागच्छत् त्वरयाऽऽजिशिरः प्रति॥
en: On the other hand, the successful Indrajita, having informed his father of what he had done, soon returned to the field of battle.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तस्तु कृष्णेन कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः। अयुध्यमानं संग्रामे वरयामास केशवम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Dhananjaya the son of Kunti being thus spoken to by Krishna chose Keshava, who was not to fight in the battle.

sa: समेत्य सह शक्रेण त्वष्टस्तेजोविमोहिताः। अमन्त्रयन्त ते सर्वे मुनिभिः सह भारत॥
en: Being pierced with the spirit of Tvashtri they untied with Shakra and all held a consultation with the Rishis, O son of Bharata.

sa: तथा तेषु च सर्वेषु तूष्णीम्भूतेषु राजसु। जामदग्न्य इदं वाक्यमब्रवीत् कुरूसंसदि॥
en: Silence having thus prevailed in the midst of those kings, the son of Jamadagni, spoke these words in the assembly of the Kurus.

sa: मा भीम साहसं कार्षीस्तिष्ठत्वेष वनस्पतिः। मा त्वां वृक्षण कर्माणि कुर्वाणमतिमानुषम्॥
en: "Do not commit such a rash act, О Bhima, let the tree stand there." You should not with a tree perform superhuman deeds.

sa: इष्टं च बहुभिर्यज्ञैः सह सूतैर्मयाऽसकृत्। आवाहाच विवाहाच सह सूतैर्मया कृताः॥
en: Many sacrifices have been performed by me in company with Suta's and all my connections and marriage, have been formed with the Suta's.

sa: यदा द्रक्ष्यसि मां कृष्ण निहतं सव्यसाचिना। पुनश्चितिस्तदा चास्य यज्ञस्याथ भविष्यति॥
en: When you will see me, O Krishna, slain by Savyasachi, then will the Punaschiti (the second part of the ceremonies) commence, O Janardana.

sa: रुक्मपुङ्खाः प्रसन्नाया मुक्ता हस्तवता त्वया। छादयन्तु शराः सूर्यं राज्ञां मार्गनिरोधकाः॥
en: Let your sharp arrows, feathered in gold, discharged by your powerful arms, stand in the way of these kings and overshadow the sun.

sa: सर्वे शान्तिपरा योधा धार्तराष्ट्रस्य पश्यतः॥ वित्रासयित्वा तत् सैन्यं द्रावयित्वा महारथान्।
en: They all became terrified in the presence of the son of Dhritarashtra. Having struck terror into the army and routed the mighty carwarriors.

sa: स सत्यसंधो बीभत्सुः सव्यसाची यथाऽच्युत। तथा त्वमेव जानासि बलवन्तं दुरासदम्॥
en: You know how devoted to truth is Vibhatsu, how mighty is Savyasachin of unimpairing glory and how hard it is to resist him.

sa: स्तोतुं प्रचक्रमे भूयो विविधैः स्तोत्रसम्भवैः। आमन्त्र्य दर्शनाकाक्षी राजा देवीं सहानुजः॥
en: The king, with his brothers, desirous of obtaining a sight of the goddess, invoked her and began to sing praises by various hymns.

sa: स्तुवन्तस्तानुपातिष्ठान् सूताश्च सह मागधैः॥ सुदेष्णां च पुरस्कृत्य मत्स्यानां च वरस्त्रियः।
en: The singers, the fabulists, acrobats and the magic-mongers began chanting pray and psalms for Pandavas in company of soothsayers and Magadhas (clowns) there.

sa: अवेक्षया महाराज तव गाण्डीवधन्वना। धर्मानुगतया बुद्ध्या न किञ्चित् साहसं कृतम्॥
en: O King, looking towards your face, the wilder of Gandiva bow acting according to his sense of duty has not shown my rashness.

sa: ततो देवान् नमस्कृत्य सुहृद्भिरभिनन्दितः॥ महेन्द्र इव पौलोम्या भार्यया स समेयिवान्।
en: Then, bowing down to the gods and congratulated by his friends, he was united with his wife like Mahendra with the daughter Pauloma.

sa: स द्रौणिमिषुणैकेन विद्ध्वा शल्यं च पञ्चभिः। ध्वजं सांयमनेश्चैव सोऽष्टाभिश्चिच्छिदे ततः॥
en: Wounding the son of Drona with one arrow and Shalya with five, he cut down the standard of Samyamani's son with eight arrows.

sa: वासुदेवसहस्रं वा फाल्गुनानां शतानि वा। आसाद्य माममोघेषु द्रविष्यन्ति दिशो दश॥
en: A thousand Vasudevas, a hundred of Falgunas, having confronted me whose arms are never struck in vain, will fly away in all directions.

sa: वार्ष्णेयं च शरैस्तीक्ष्णैः कम्पयामास रोषित:। मुहुरभ्यर्दयन् भीष्मः प्रहस्य स्वनवत् तदा॥
en: With his sharp arrows the angry Bhishma made the Vrishni chief (Krishna) to shiver; laughing loudly also he made Krishna very much astonished.

sa: निवार्य महतीं सेनां तावकानां नरर्षभः। आससाद रथं शून्यं भीमसेनस्य संयुगे॥
en: That foremost of men, checking the mighty army of your sons, approached, in that battle, the car of Bhima left empty by himself.

sa: प्रवृत्तिमधिगच्छन्तु न हि शुद्ध्यति मे मनः। त एवं समनुज्ञाताः शूरा विक्रान्तयोधिनः॥ बाढमित्येवमुक्त्वा तु सर्वं पुरुषमानिनः। मध्यन्दिनगते सूर्ये प्रययुः सर्व एव हि॥ केकया द्रौपदेयाश्च धृष्टकेतुश्च वीर्यवान्। अभिमन्युं पुरस्कृत्य महत्या सेनया वृताः॥
en: Let intelligence be brought (of those two heroes). My mind is not unmisgiving". Thus commanded, the five Kaikeya princes, the sons of Draupadi, and the highly powerful Dhrishtaketu all powerful warriors, endued with heroism and proud of their manliness, saying 'yea' (to the words of Yudhishthira) marched forward when the sun had reached the meridian, placing Abhimanyu at their head and being supported by a mighty division of troops.

sa: ततः प्रववृते भूयः संग्रामो लोमहर्षणः। तावकानां परेषां च समरे विजयैषिणाम्॥
en: Then again commenced a fearful and hairstring battle between the troops and both the sides, both parties being eager to defeat one other.

sa: ध्वजैस्तत्रापविद्धैश्च कार्मुकैस्तोमरैस्तथा। प्रासैस्तथा गदाभिश्च परिघैः कम्पनैस्तथा॥ शक्तिभिः कवचैश्चित्रैः कणपैरङ्कुशैरपि। निस्त्रीशैविमलैश्चापि स्वर्णपुङ्खैः शरैस्तथा।॥ परिस्तोमैः कुथाभिश्च कम्बलैश्च महाधनैः। भूति भरतश्रेष्ठ स्रग्दामैरिव चित्रिता॥
en: O best of the Bharata race! the battle field, strewn with broken standards bow, lances, housings of elephants, costly blankets, bearded darts, maces, clubs with iron spikes, Kampanas, various sorts of armours, arrows with golden wings, looked as if it were covered with garlands of flowers.

sa: स तस्य हृदयं भित्त्वा पीत्वा शोणितमाहवे। जगाम धरणी बाणो लोहितार्द्रवरच्छदः॥
en: That arrow, penetrating through Shankha's heart and drinking his life, blood, struck on the ground with its body rocked in the crimson fluid.

sa: हतं तमात्मजं दृष्ट्वा विराट: प्राद्रवद् भयात्। उत्सृज्य समरे द्रोणं व्यात्ताननमिवान्तकम्॥
en: Beholding his own son slain, Virata, fled out of fear, leaving Drona in battle who then looked like Death himself with yawning jaws.

sa: तत् तथा पीडितं तेन माधवेन यशस्विना। प्रदुद्राव भयाद् रक्षस्त्यक्त्वा सात्यकिमाहवे॥
en: Thus afflicted sore by that high souled scion of Madhu's race, the Rakshasa fled out of fear, leaving Satyaki (victorious) on the field.

sa: कृतवर्मा रणे भीमं शरैरार्छन्महारथः। प्रच्छादयामास च तं महामेघो रविं यथा।॥
en: Then in that battle, Kritavarma afflicted the inighty car-warrior Bhima, virtually covering the latter (with arrows), like masses of clouds covering the sun.

sa: ततः क्रोधात् प्रजज्वाल धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। यथा युगान्ते भूतानि दिधक्षुरिव पावकः॥
en: Then Yudhishthira the son of Dharma burnt with rage, like the fire that burns at the end of a Yuga consuming all creatures.

sa: एवं संनोद्य सर्वाणि स्वान्यनीकानि पार्षतः। भीमसेनस्य जग्राह पाणिं सत्पुरुषैर्वृतः ॥
en: Thus urging all his troops, the Prishata prince surrounded by many great warriors went to protect one of the wings of Bhima's troops.

sa: तं तु दृष्ट्वा महाव्यूहं तावकानां महारथः। युधिष्ठिरोऽब्रवीत् तूर्णं पार्षत पृतनापतिम्॥
en: Seeing that mighty array of your warriors, the mighty car-warrior Yudhishthira speedily addressing Prishata's son, the generalissimo of his army said these words.

sa: अशोभन्त रणे राजन् पात्यमानानि सर्वशः। तेऽन्योन्यं समरे सेने युध्यमाने नराधिप॥
en: Falling on all sides, appeared beautiful, O king. O ruler of men, when the two armies fought with each other in that battle,

sa: मातुः समागमो यश्च तत् सर्वं प्रत्यवेदयत्। तच्च सर्वं यथावृत्तमनुसस्मार पाण्डवः॥
en: He also reminded Arjuna of the circumstances under which the latter met his mother. Then the of Pandu also remembered them a right.

sa: सोऽन्तरा कृतवर्माणं काम्बोजं च सुदक्षिणम्। अभ्ययाद् वर्जयन् द्रोणं मैनाकमिव पर्वतम्॥
en: Shunning Drona who stood immovable like the Mainaka mountain, Arjuna then took his stand between Kritavarman and Sudakshina, the ruler of the Kambojas.

sa: नातिक्रम्यं भवेत् तच्च वनचं मम भीषितम्॥ भवान् सेनापतिर्मह्यं वासुदेवेन सम्मितः।
en: The words uttered by me should not be transgressed. You have been appointed to commander of our force with the approval of Vasudeva.

sa: तदवेक्ष्य कृतं कर्म राक्षसेन बलीयसा। दिवि देवाः सगन्धर्वा मुनयश्चापि विस्मिताः॥
en: Beholding that mighty feat achieved by the puissant Rakshasa, the celestial in the heavens, along with the Gandharvas and the sages were amazed.

sa: सा तु यौधिष्ठिरी सेना गाड्नेयशरपीडिता। सिंहेनेव विनिर्भिन्ना शुक्ला गौरिव गोपते॥
en: Afflicted with the arrows of son of Ganga (Bhishma) the army of Yudhishthira appeared like a kine of white colour afflicted by lion.

sa: ततः प्रदुद्रुवुः शेषास्तव पुत्रा महाहवे। तं कालमिव मन्यन्तो भीमसेनं महाबलम्॥
en: Then considering the highly puissant Bhima to be the Destroyer incarnate, the rest of your sons, O ruler of men fled with haste.

sa: वीक्षांचक्रुः समन्तात् ते पाण्डवा भयपीडिताः। त्रातारं नाध्यगच्छन्त गावः शीतार्दिता इव॥
en: Afflicted with fear, the Pandava troops looked around, and not finding any protector, they appeared like a herd of kine afflicted with cold.

sa: तं श्रुत्वा निनदं घोरं तव सैन्यस्य भारत। मारुतोद्भूतवेगस्य सागरस्येव पर्वणि॥
en: Then 0 Bharata, hearing that fierce distressful shrink uttered by your troops, that resembled the roar of the tempest-tossed ocean in a Parva,

sa: सात्यकिस्तु रणे हित्वा गुरुपुत्रं महारथम्। द्रोणं विव्याध विंशत्या सर्वपारशवैः शरैः॥
en: Then abandoning that mighty car-warrior that son of the preceptor Drona, Satyaki, picrced Drona with twenty shafts of sharpness like that battle axe.

sa: तद् बलं प्रद्रुतं दृष्ट्वा पुत्रो दुर्योधनस्तव। पुरस्कृत्य रणे भीष्मं सर्वसैन्यपुरस्कृतः॥
en: Seeing that army thus routed, your son Duryodhana, placing Bhishma at the head of all the troops, and himself marching in the van.

sa: चिच्छेद रथिनां बाणैः शिरांसि भरतर्षभ॥ साङ्गदा बाहवश्चैव धनूंषि च समन्ततः।
en: He cut off with his arrows the heads of hundreds of car-warriors and also their arms decked with Angadas, and also their bows.

sa: संजय उवाच राजशतसहस्राणि ततः क्षत्रियपुङ्गवाः॥ श्वेतं सेनापतिं शूरं पुरस्कृत्य महारथाः।
en: Sanjaya said O king, hundreds and thousands of the foremost of Kshatriyas, all brave great carwarriors placed their general Shveta in their front.

sa: तस्मिन् रात्रिमुखे घोरे पाण्डवा वृष्णिभिः सह। सुंजयाच दुराधर्षा मन्त्राय समुपाविशन्॥
en: In the beginning of that dread time of night, the Pandavas along with the Vrishnis and the invincible Srinjayas, sat together for consultation.

sa: नियतं समवाप्स्यामि सर्वमेतद् यथेप्सितम्। यस्य मे पुरुषव्याघ्र भवान् पक्षे व्यवस्थितः॥
en: I am sure of obtaining all those things that I may desire, I, O foremost of men, on whose side you are staying.

sa: दिवसे दिवसे प्राप्ते भीष्मः शान्तनवो युधि। आसुरानकरोद् व्यूहान् पैशाचानथ राक्षसान्॥
en: Day after day Bhishma the son of Shantanu used to dispose of his troops in battle arrays such as Pisachas, Rakshasas, and Asuras.

sa: यथाप्रतिज्ञं कौरव्य स चापि समितिञ्जयः। पार्थानामकरोदं भीष्मः सततं समिति क्षयम्॥
en: In perfect harmony with his vow, O foremost of the Kurus, the ever-victorious Bhishma continuously went on slaughtering the troops of the Pandavas.

sa: युध्यमानं महेष्वासं विनिघ्नन्तं पराशरैः। पञ्चालाः पाण्डवैः सार्धं सर्वे ते नाभ्यवारयन्॥
en: The Panchalas accompanied by the Pandavas were incapable of withstanding that fierce bowman as he fought on, slaying the foe with his shafts.

sa: पुत्रास्तु तव गाङ्गेयं समन्तात् पर्यवारयन्। महत्या सेनया सार्धं ततो युद्धमवर्तत॥
en: Your son of Duryodhana supported by a mighty division protected Ganga's son by surrounding him on all sides.. Then ensued a terrible combat.

sa: संजय उवाच सात्यकिं दंशितं युद्धे भीष्मायाभ्युद्यतं रणे। आर्ण्यशृङ्गिर्महेष्वासो वारयामास संयुगे॥
en: Sanjaya said The son of Rishyashringa, that fierce bowman resisted in battle Satyaki, who clad in mail was rushing towards Bhishma in battle.

sa: अद्येदानीं विजानीमः सन्ति षण्ढाः सशृङ्गकाः। मद्विधो नापि नृपतिस्त्वयि युक्तः कथञ्चन॥
en: A ruler of man like myself should never you being clad in a coat of mail, you who are the slave of Kansa.

sa: पुनः पुनः समाश्वस्य प्रायुध्यत मदोत्कटः। अर्जुनस्तु रणे राजन् योधयन् संव्यराजत॥
en: Furiously fought with the Pandavas comforting his own troops at the same time. Arjuna also, O king, engaged in battle appeared very beautiful.

sa: कृपं विकर्णं शल्यं च विद्ध्वा बहुभिरायसैः। चकार विरथांश्चैव कौन्तेयः श्वेतवाहनः॥
en: Then the son of Kunti, owning white steeds, having pierced Kripa, Vikarna, and Shalya with many iron arrows, deprived them of their cars.

sa: संजय उवाच एवमाभाष्यमाणोऽपि भ्रातृभिः कुरुनन्दनः। नोवाच वाग्यतः किंचिद् गच्छत्येव युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Sanjaya said O descendant of Kuru, though he was thus addressed by his brothers, yet he continued to proceed without uttering a word.

sa: ऋषयश्च महाभागाः पुरस्कृत्य शतक्रतुम्। समीयुस्तत्र सहिता द्रष्टुं तद् वैशसं महत्॥
en: The highly blessed Rishis came there in a body with Shatakratu (Indra) at their head, so that they might see the great slaughter.

sa: तेन सत्त्ववता संख्ये शूरेणाहवशोभिना। कृतिना समरे राजन् संधिर्मवतु मा चिरम्॥
en: Therefore, O monarch, let peace be soon concluded with that truthful hero that ornament of the fled, accomplished in all modes of warfare.

sa: देवगर्भसमः संख्ये मनुष्यैरधिको युधि॥ व्यपनीतोऽद्य मन्युर्मे यस्त्वा प्रति पुरा कृतः।
en: You certainly are equal to a celestial child, and are far-superior to men. I relinquish today the wrath I formerly harbored against you.

sa: स हि शक्तो रणे राजंस्त्रातुमस्मान् महाभयात्। त्रिदशानिव गोविन्दः सततं सुमहाभयात्॥
en: O monarch, he only was capable of saving us from the great dangers of battle, iike Govinda protecting the celestials from all calamities.

sa: तथैव पार्षतेनापि काल्यमानं बलं तव। अभवत् सर्वतो दीप्तं शुष्कं वनमिवाग्निना॥
en: So also your troops afflicted by the arrows of Parshata, appeared to blaze up at every place, like a dry forest on fire.

sa: अथवा योगिनामेव कुले भवति धीमताम्। एतद्धि दुर्लभतरं लोके जन्म यदीदृशम्॥
en: Or he is born into a family of intelligent devotees; for, such a birth as this is difficult to attain to this work.

sa: योऽन्तः सुखोऽन्तरारामस्तथाऽन्तर्कोतिरेव यः। स योगी ब्रह्मनिर्वाणं ब्रह्मभूतोऽधिगच्छति॥ न तेषु रमते
en: That Yogi, whose happiness is within himself whose recreations are within himself, becoming one with Brahma, obtains Brahma Nirvana (Self extinction in God).

sa: अथास्य धनुषो बाणा निश्चरन्तः सहस्रशः। व्याप्य सर्वा दिश: पेतुर्नागाश्वरथपत्तिषु ॥
en: Thousands of arrows not shot from his bow fell, covering cardinal points, upon the elephants, steeds, chariots and foot-soldiers (of the hostile array).

sa: ततः कुरूणामाचार्यः श्रुत्वा पुत्रस्य ते वचः। सेनां प्रहर्षयन् सर्वामिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Thereupon the preceptor of the Kurus hearing these words of your son, spoke the following words, thereby imparting great delight to the troops.

sa: विहाय कामान् यः सर्वान् पुमांश्चरति निःस्पृहः। निर्ममो निरहंकारः स शान्तिमधिगच्छति॥
en: The man, who moves about casting of all desires, and being freed from attachments, carvings for things, and egoism (pride), attains to peace.

sa: नास्ति बुद्धिरयुक्तस्य न चायुक्तस्य भावना। न चाभावयतः शान्तिरशान्तस्य कुतः सुखम्॥
en: Undevotional man has no understanding, he has no contemplation, he has no peace. And where is happiness for him who has no peace?

sa: न स्मराम्यनृतं तावन्न स्मरामि पराजयम्। न स्मरामि प्रतिश्रुत्य किंचिदप्यनृतं कृतम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Thereupon, O monarch, in the camp of the Pandavas, chonchs and drums and Mridangas together with the Anakas, were simultaneously sounded.

sa: यततो ह्यपि कौन्तेय पुरुषस्य विपश्चितः। इन्द्रियाणि प्रमाथीनि हरन्ति प्रसभं मनः॥
en: The madly boisterous senses, O son of Kunti, steal by force the mind of even that wise man who is striving (for emancipation).

sa: तं कृपः शरवर्षण महता समवारयत्। विव्याध च रणे विप्रो धृष्टकेतुममर्षणम्॥
en: Thereupon Kripa encompassed him with a unighty shower of arrows; thus holding Dhristaketu in check, the Vipra fought on with him, in battle.

sa: लक्ष्मणः क्षत्रदेवेन विमर्दमकरोद् भृशम्। यथा विष्णुः पुरा राजन् हिरण्याक्षेण संयुगे॥
en: Lakshmana was engaged in a terrible combat with Kshatradeva, as, O monarch, Vishnu was, in days of yore, engaged with the Daitya Hiranyakashipu.

sa: तस्य संजनयन् हर्षं कुरुवृद्धः पितामहः। सिंहनादं विनद्योच्चैः शङ्ख दध्मौ प्रतापवान्॥
en: Then the older of the Kurus, the mighty Grandsire Bhishma, roaring like a lion, blew his conch, thus affording him (Duryodhana) great delight.

sa: निवृत्तो हि महाबाहुरमितौजा वृकोदरः। वरान् वरान् हि कौन्तेयो रथोदारान् हनिष्यति॥
en: Already the mighty-armed Vrikodara of immeasurable prowess, has turned back; this son of Kunti will now certainly slay many foremost of our car-warriors.

sa: पितरं तु परिप्रेप्सुः क्षत्रधर्मा यतव्रतः। सिद्धिं चास्य परां काझन्शोणाश्वः संन्यवर्तत॥
en: Desirous of supporting his father (Dhrishtadyumna) and wishing his complete success, Kshatradarman of regulated vows followed (in a car drawn by chestnut steeds).

sa: स तेषु विसृजन् बाणान् भीमो नागेष्वशोभत। भुवनेष्विव सर्वेषु गभस्तीनुदितो रविः॥
en: Scattering arrows on that herd of elephants, Bhima appeared beautiful, like the sun scattering his shining rays on all objects of the world.

sa: तया ह्युत्पादित: पुण्यः स ह्रदः सागरोपमः। तां धारयामास तदा दुर्धरा पर्वतैरपि॥ शतं वर्षसहस्राणां शिरसैव पिनाकधूक्। मरोस्तु पश्चिमे भागे केतुमालो महीपते॥
en: That sacred lake like an ocean has been formed by Ganga herself. Ganga, incapable of being held by even the mountains, was held for one thousand years by the wilder of Pinaka on his head. O king, on the western side of the Meru is Ketumala.

sa: ततोऽर्जुनस्याथ परैः सार्धं समभवद् रणः। तादृशोयादृशोनान्यः श्रुतो दृष्टोऽपि वा क्वचित्॥
en: Then there took place a battle between Arjuna and his opponents, the like of which had never been seen or heard of before.

sa: न वैनतेयो गरुडः प्रशंसति महाजनम्। दृष्ट्वा सुपर्णोऽपचितिं महत्या अपि भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, Vinata's son Garuda never asks the assistance of many followers when he sees even a large number of birds.

sa: ततो हर्ष समागम्य वासुदेवधनंजयौ। दध्मतुः पुरुषव्याघ्रौ दिव्यौ शङ्खौ रथे स्थितौ॥
en: Those lion of men, Vasudeva and Arjuna who were seated on one car felt the greatest joy and both blew their celestial conchs.

sa: सोऽन्यदादाव बलवान् सज्यं कृत्वा च कार्मुकम्। भोपल्यापातयत् केतुं धनुरश्वांश्च मारिष॥
en: Taking up and stringing another bow, that puissant hero (Jayadratha) cut down, O sire, the standard, the bow and the steeds of Bhima.

sa: युद्धे ह्याशीविषाकारान् राजपुत्रान् रणे रिपून्। पूर्व निहत्य संग्रामे पश्चादा निरभ्ययात्॥
en: (He went on)-Having at first slain many hostile princes resembling snakes of virulent poison, the son of Arjuna has followed in their wake.

sa: निरीक्षमाणास्तु वयं परे चायोधनं शनैः। अपयाता महाराज ग्लानि प्राप्ता विचेतसः॥
en: Gazed at by the foe and nearly senseless and overpowered with fatigue, we then, O mighty monarch, slowly left the field of battle.

sa: ततस्तौ निश्चयं कृत्वा तस्मिन् कार्येऽथ दम्पती। वरयांचक्रतुः कन्यां दशार्णाधिपतेः सुताम्॥
en: Then that royal couple, making a firm resolution as regards that work, chose as a bride the maiden daughter of the king Dasharnakas.

sa: संजय उवाच अथैनं विलपन्तं तं कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम्। कृष्णद्वैपायनस्तत्र आजगाम महानृषिः॥
en: Sanjaya said Thus when the son of Kunti, king Yudhishthira, was indulging in lamentations, there came to him the mighty sage Krishna Dvaipayana.

sa: लेभे गर्भ यथाकालं विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा। पार्षतस्य महीपाल यथा मां नारदोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Agreeably to the decrees of destiny the wife of Prishata, in due time, conceived, as Narada informed me, O ruler of the Earth.

sa: पुनः पुनर्याच्यमानो दिष्टमित्यब्रवीच्छिवः। न तदन्यच्च भविता भवितव्यं हि तत् तथा॥
en: Though repeatedly solicited, Shiva only said “It is decreed by destiny. It shall not be otherwise, but when as I have told you”.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा ततो रामो विनिःश्वस्य महामनाः। तूष्णीमांसीत् ततः कन्या प्रोवाच भृगुनन्दनम्॥
en: Then the high-souled Rama, having thus spoken, fetched a deep sign and remained silent. Then that maiden spoke to the descendant of Bhrigu.

sa: अथ दस्युगणाः श्रुत्वा दृष्ट्वा चैनं तथाविधम्॥ सम्भूय तस्य नृपतः समारब्धाश्चिकीर्षितुम्।
en: Then certain robbers hearing of the prince and seeing him to be such banded together and endeavoured to do mischief to the king.

sa: एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु दुपदो वै महीपतिः। अपत्यार्थ महाराज तोषयामास शङ्करम्॥
en: And during this time the highly intelligent king Drupada, pleased by worship, O mighty king, the God Shankara for the sake of offspring.

sa: जवेनाभ्यद्रवद् द्रोणं महता नि:स्वनेन च। पाण्डवाः सोमकैः सार्धं ततो युद्धमवर्तत॥
en: The Pandavas supported by the Somakas furiously assaulted Drona, creating a loud din. Thereupon a fearful battle commenced between them and Drona's troops.

sa: आजहार महायज्ञं प्रजा धर्मेण पालयन्। निरर्गलं राजसूयमश्वमेधं च तं विभुः॥
en: Cherishing his subjects virtuously, that lord without any hindrance, accomplished one hundred of that mighty sacrifice Ashvamedha together with the sacrifice called Jaruthya.

sa: सहस्रं यत्र मातङ्गा गच्छन्ति पर्वतोपमाः। सौवर्णं चाभवत् सर्वं सदः परमभास्वरम्॥
en: were here wandering many great clephants like a various hills. The upper and lower rings in his sacrificial stakes were made of gold.

sa: वाश्चि यूपा यावन्त अश्वमेधे महामखे। ते तथैव पुनश्चान्ते तावन्तः काञ्चनाऽभवन्॥
en: In that great Horse-sacrifice of his, he gave away unlimited wealth and in other sacrifices also he gave away equal amount of gold.

sa: तत एनं समुद्विग्नाः सर्व एवाभिदुद्रुवुः। तपोधनास्ते सहसा काश्या च कुरुनन्दन॥
en: Then did all those ascetics and the princess of Kashi,Odelighter of the race of Kuru, being filled with anxiety, began to comfort him,

sa: अथवा ते मतिस्तत्र राजपुत्रि न वर्तते। यावच्छाल्वपतिं वीरं योजनयाम्यत्र कर्माणि॥
en: If, O princess, you are not of that opinion, I shall urge that hero, the king of the Shalvas, to the present matter.

sa: ततो रामः प्रादुरासीत् प्रज्वलन्निव तेजसा। शिष्यैः परिवृतो राजन् जटाचीरधरो मुनिः॥
en: Then did Rama come there as if blazing with energy, the anchorite having matted hairs wearing deer skin was surrounded by his disciples.

sa: आर्ती तामाह स मुनिः शैखावत्यो महातपाः। निःश्वसन्ती सती बालां दुःखशोकपरायणाम्॥
en: That anchorite, of eminent devotion, said to that chaste lady who was in extreme difficuity and who was sighing in grief and distress.

sa: संजय उवाच एवमुक्त्वा हृषीकेशं स्वयमात्मानमात्मना। संदिदेशार्जुनो नर्दन् वासविः केशवं प्रभुम्॥
en: Sanjaya said Having spoken these words to Hrishikesha and having said so to his own self also, Vasava's son (Arjuna) once more addressed

sa: या गतिर्युध्यमानानां शूराणामनिवर्तिनाम्। हत्वारीन् निहतानां च संग्रामे तां गतिं व्रज॥
en: May that end be yours which they attain who fight and never retreat or who fall in battle after slaying their numerous foes!

sa: मया प्रतिज्ञा महती जयद्रथवधे कृता। श्वोऽस्मि हन्ता दुरात्मानं पुत्रघ्नमिति केशव॥
en: I have taken a terrible oath in vowing to slaughter Jayadratha. Tomorrow shall I slay, O Keshava that wicked-souled slayer of my son.

sa: उत्तमौजास्तथा राजन् रथोदारो मतो मम। युधामन्युश्च विक्रान्तो रतोदारो मतो मम॥
en: In the same way, O king, Uttamaujas is a mighty Ratha is my opinion; and the powerful Yudhishthira too is a mighty Ratha.

sa: पयापि चोक्तास्ते वीरा वचनं धर्मसंहितम्। नान्यथा प्रकरिष्यन्ति धर्मात्मानो हि पाण्डवाः॥
en: Those heroes will not also disregard the righteous words that I shall speak to them for the Pandavas are all of righteous soul.

sa: भ्रातृणां निधनं श्रुत्वा पुत्राणां च सुयोधन। भीमसेनेन निहतो दुष्कृतानि स्मरिष्यसि॥
en: Hearing of the death of your brother and of your son, O Suyodhana, and being struck by Bhimasena you will remember your vices.

sa: वासुदेवसहस्रं वा फाल्गुनानां शतानि वा। आसाद्य माममोघेणुं द्रविष्यन्ति दिशो दश॥
en: A thousand Vasudevas, a hundred of Falgunas, having confronted me whose arms are never struck in vain, will fly away in all directions.

sa: भीमसेनो महाबाहुस्तव पुत्रस्य वै बले। सापि मज्जावसामांसैः प्रदिग्धा रुधिरेण च॥
en: Bhimasena produced a fierce carnage in the force of your son. Smeared with fat, marrow, serum and flesh, and be spattered with blood,

sa: सत्यव्रतश्च भद्रं ते पुरुमित्रश्च भारत। एते मद्राधिपरथं पालयन्तः स्थिता रणे॥
en: Satyavrata, Purumitra and the mighty carwarrior Vikarna, these stationed themselves in the filed for protecting the chariot of the ruler of the Madras.

sa: ततो द्रोणश्च भीष्मश्च तथा शल्यश्च मारिष। भीमसेनं रणे क्रुद्धाश्छादयांचक्रिरे शरैः॥
en: Thereat Drona and Bhishma and also Shalya, O sire, inflamed with rage, covered Bhimasena in that battle with a thick shower of) arrows.

sa: तौ तत्र समरे शूरौ समेतौ युद्धदुर्मदौ। ददृशुः सर्वराजानः कुरवः पाण्डवास्तथा॥
en: Then all the monarchs belonging to the Kuru and the Pandava armies saw those two heroes, those foremost of car-warriors, engaged in battle.

sa: स सम्प्रहारस्तुमुलः कटुकः शोणितोदकः। प्रावर्तत कुरूणां च पाण्डवानां च भारत॥
en: That dreadful and fierce fight, O Bharata, between the Kurus and the Pandus created a river of blood in the field of battle.

sa: स कृच्छ्रामहमापन्नो न शक्तस्तर्तुमापदम्। अहो धिक् कां गतिं त्वद्य गमिष्यामि सबान्धवः। सर्वैः सह मृतं श्रेयो न च मे जीवितं क्षमम्॥
en: The distress into which I have fallen is great; I do not know the means of escape (from it). Alas! What means shall I adopt with my friends and relatives! It is better that I should die with them; I am unable to live (any longer).

sa: मर्यादेयं कृता तेन धा वै श्वेतकेतुना॥ कोपात्कमलपत्राक्षि यदर्थं तन्निबोध मे।
en: O lotus eyed one, the present virtuous practice was established by that Svetaketu in anger. I shall tell you why he did it.

sa: तत इष्टेऽहनि प्राप्ते मुहूर्ते साधुसम्मते। जग्राह विधिवत् पाणिं मात्र्याः पाण्डुराधिपः॥
en: The king Pandu, on an auspicious day and at the time indicated by the wise accepted the hands of Madri in due form.

sa: हूयमाने तथा चैव तक्षकः सपुरंदरः। आकाशे ददृशे चैव क्षणेन व्यथितस्तदा॥
en: As the libations were continually poured into the fire, Takshaka with Indra, anxious and afflicted, became visible in a moment in the sky.

sa: अनुगृह्णन् प्रजाः सर्वाः सर्वधर्मभृतां वरः। अविशेषेण सर्वेषां हितं चक्रे युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: The foremost of all virtuous men Yudhishthira, ever kind to all his subjects, always acted without any distinction for the good of all.

sa: सौमित्रिस्तु परं दैन्यं जगाम सुमहामतिः। रामपादौ समासाद्य वक्ष्यामि किमहं गतः॥
en: But the high-souled Lakşmaņa became greatly sorry stricken with the thought as to what he should relate on approaching the feet of Rāma.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततस्ताः पाण्डवश्रेष्ठः सर्वा एव विशाम्पते। तस्माच्छापाददीनात्मा मोक्षयामास वीर्यवान्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : O king, thereupon that best of the Pandavas (Arjuna) of great prowess gladly delivered all of them from that curse.

sa: इदमाभरणं सौम्य धराणार्थं द्विजोत्तम। प्रतिगृह्णीष्व भद्रं ते प्रसादं कर्तुमर्हसि ॥
en: O foremost of twice-born ones, O gentle one, do you take this ornament; may good betide you. Do you be propitiated with me.

sa: स नोऽपृच्छद् दुःखमूलमुक्तवत्यो वयं च तम्। श्रुत्वा तत्र यथावृत्तमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: He asked us the cause of our sorrow and we told him all. Having heard what had happened, he thus spoke to us,

sa: रुरुरुवाच कथं हिंसितवान्सन्स राजा जनमेजयः। सर्पा वा हिंसितास्तत्र किमर्थं द्विजसत्तम॥
en: Ruru said: O best of the twice-born, why did king Janamejaya become the destroyer of the snakes and how did he destroy them?

sa: यदा त्वया वृतो भर्ता वृत एव तदा मया। सखीभर्ता हि धर्मेण भर्ता भवति शोभने॥ पूज्यासि मम मान्या च ज्येष्ठा च ब्राह्मणी ह्यसि। त्वत्तोऽपि मे पूज्यतमो राजर्षिः किं न वेत्थ तत्॥
en: Therefore, I am not afraid of you. When you chose the king as your husband, I too did the same. O beautiful lady, a friend's husband is one's own husband according to the precept of religion. You are a daughter of a Brahmana and therefore you deserve my greatest worship and regard. Do you no know that this royal sage (Yayati) is the object of greater esteem to me?

sa: तमब्रवीत्सत्यधृतिं तप्यमानं पितामहः। किमिदं कुरुषे शेष प्रजानां स्वस्ति वै कुरु॥
en: The Grandsire, addressing that penancepractising ascetic, said, “O Shesha, what are you doing? let the welfare of the worlds also engage your thoughts.

sa: समा हि कौरवेयाणां वयं ते चैव पुत्रक। नैते विषममिच्छेयुर्धर्मयुक्ता मनस्विनः॥
en: O son, in their eyes we (Kurus) and the Pandavas are equal. Those wise and virtuous men will make no difference between us,

sa: अग्निरुवाच नैतदेवं यथा यूयं मन्यध्वमसुरार्दनाः। गरुडो बलवानेष मम तुल्यश्च तेजसा॥
en: Agni said : O persecutors of the Asuras, it is not as you think. It is mighty Garuda, equal to me in splendour.

sa: स तं तपोरतं मन्दं शनैः क्षपयते तुदन्। जरत्कारुं तपोलब्धं मन्दात्मानमचेतसम्॥
en: He (Time) is slowly killing the wretch Jaratkaru, engaged in asceticism, having been tempted by its merits but wanting in prudence and heart.

sa: दत्त्वा तस्यासनं शुभं पाद्यमर्थ्य तथैव च। मधुपर्कं च मद्रेशः पप्रच्छागमनेऽर्थिताम्॥
en: The king of Madra, having given him a white seat, water for washing his feet and Arghya, asked the reason of his coming.

sa: एवमुक्तः स काकुत्स्थो लक्ष्मणेन महात्मना। उवाच परया प्रीत्या सौमित्रिं मित्रवत्सलः॥
en: The intelligent Lakşmaņa, the son of Sumitrā, having said this, Rāma, the descendant of Käkutstha and fond of friends, with great delight said.

sa: तत्र भैक्षं समाजहुर्ब्राह्मणी वृत्तिमाश्रिताः। तान् सम्प्राप्तांस्तथा वीराञ्जज्ञिरे न नराः क्वचित्॥
en: Adopting the life of the Brahmanas, they begged their food there (in that city). No man recognised those heroes when they stopped there.

sa: सहस्रं प्रददौ कृष्णो गवामयुतमेव च। श्रीमान् माधुर देश्यानां दोग्ध्रीणां पुण्यवर्चसाम्॥
en: Ten thousand well complexioned kine, belonging to the country of Mathura and yielding much milk were also presented (o the Pandavas) by Krishna.

sa: धर्मज्ञश्च कृतज्ञश्च बुद्ध्या च परिनिष्ठितः। शशास पृथिवीं स्फीतां धर्मेण सुसमाहितः॥
en: He was pious, grateful and used to perform nothing without proper deliberation. And treading tracks he used to govern his subjects very carefully.

sa: देवानां समयस्त्वेष वसूनां संश्रुतो मया। जातं जातं मोक्षयिष्ये जन्मतो मानुषादिति॥
en: My agreement with the celestials Vasus was that I should free them from their human birth as soon as each would be born.

sa: ज्ञातुमिच्छामहे ब्रह्मन् कोभवानिह न: स्थितः। किमर्थं चैव नः शोच्याननुशोचसि सत्तम॥
en: O Brahmana, we wish to know who you are that stand near us and why? O excellent iman, are you sorrowing for us?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः स्रस्तोत्तरपटः सप्रस्वेदः सवेपथुः। विवेशाधिरथो रङ्गं यष्टिप्राणो ह्वयन्निव॥
en: Vaishampayana said: Thereupon Adhiratha (Karna's father), with his sheet loosely hanging down, trembling and perspiring, supporting himself on a stuff, entered the arena.

sa: मा शुचः पुरुषव्याघ्र कालस्य गतिरीदृशी। त्वद्विधा नहि शोचन्ति बुद्धिमन्तो मनस्विनः॥
en: Do you not grieve, O foremost of men, for such is the cause of time. The intelligent people like you do not grieve.

sa: नारदं प्रत्युवाचेदं धर्मराजो महामनाः। सभाः कथय ताः सर्वाः श्रोतुमिच्छामहे वयम्॥
en: The high-minded Dharmaraja then thus spoke to Narada, "describe to us all those assembly-halls. We desire to hear (all about them) from you.
